nodes.description: Bengal Tiger (Panthera tigris tigris) is classified under Mammals. Description: The Bengal Tiger is one of the most powerful predators in the wild. Known for its strength, stealth, and beautiful striped coat, it plays a vital role in maintaining the balance of forest ecosystems. It belongs to the Cats /  Felids group and is found in India, China, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Bhutan., mainly in Forests, mangroves, and grasslands.. Its diet consists of Deer, wild pigs, nilgai, gaur, macaques, hares, reptiles, and peafowl., and it prefers Dense forests, water sources, and large territories while avoiding Human disturbance and habitat loss. It measures about Up to 110 CM and weighs around 100–260 KG. With a lifespan of 15–20 Years, gestation period of 3.5 months, and clutch size of 2–4 Cubs, its conservation status is not evaluated.. Found in: India, China, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Bhutan.. Likes: Dense forests, water sources, and large territories. Dislikes: Human disturbance and habitat loss. Fun facts: Every tiger has unique stripes — just like human fingerprints — no two are ever alike! Weight: 100–260 KG. Length: Up to 110 CM.

story_description.hi: बंगाल टाइगर जंगल का सबसे शक्तिशाली शिकारी जीवों में से एक है। अपनी ताकत, चुपके से शिकार करने की क्षमता और सुंदर धारियों वाले शरीर के लिए प्रसिद्ध यह जीव वन पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र का संतुलन बनाए रखने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है। यह बिल्ली कुल (Felids) समूह से संबंधित है और भारत, चीन, बांग्लादेश, नेपाल तथा भूटान में पाया जाता है, मुख्य रूप से जंगलों, मैंग्रोव क्षेत्रों और घास के मैदानों में। इसका भोजन हिरण, जंगली सूअर, नीलगाय, गौर, मकाक बंदर, खरगोश, सरीसृप और मोर होते हैं। इसे घने जंगल, जल स्रोत और बड़े क्षेत्र पसंद होते हैं, जबकि यह मानव हस्तक्षेप और आवास के नुकसान से बचना पसंद करता है। इसकी लंबाई लगभग 110 सेमी तक होती है और वजन लगभग 100–260 किलोग्राम तक होता है। इसका जीवनकाल 15–20 वर्ष होता है, गर्भावधि लगभग 3.5 महीने की होती है, और एक बार में 2–4 शावकों को जन्म देता है। इसकी संरक्षण स्थिति का अभी मूल्यांकन नहीं किया गया है

It measures about  45–63 CM and weighs around 1–2.5 KG. 
With a lifespan of 15–20 Years, gestation period of 28–35 days, and clutch size of 1–4 eggs, 
its conservation status is Least Concern .. Found in: Widely distributed across North and South America. Likes: Tall trees, quiet forests, rocky nesting sites. Dislikes: Habitat destruction and disturbance near nest. Fun facts: They can turn their heads about 270° — almost all the way around Their talons are so powerful they can kill prey larger than themselves, including skunks! 🦉 Weight: 1–2.5 KG. Asiatic Lion (Panthera leo persica) is classified under Mammals. Description: Asiatic Lion 1 is a mammal belonging to the Cats /  Felids group. 
It is found across Gujarat (Gir Forest), India, typically in Dry forests, scrublands, and grasslands. 
It feeds on Deer, antelope, wild cattle, and livestock and enjoys Open forests, grasslands, and areas with abundant prey., while avoiding Human disturbance and habitat loss.. 
This species measures around 170–250 CM and weighs approximately 110–190 KG. 
It lives up to 15-20 Years , with a gestation period of About 110 days and clutch size of 1–4 Cubs. 
Its conservation status is Endangered.. Found in: Gujarat (Gir Forest), India. Likes: Open forests, grasslands, and areas with abundant prey.. Dislikes: Human disturbance and habitat loss.. Fun facts: Lions are the only cats that live in groups called prides. A lion’s roar can be heard up to 8 kilometers away. Female lions do most of the hunting for the pride. Asiatic lions, found only in India’s Gir Forest, are endangered big cats distinguished by their smaller manes and a unique belly fold Weight: 110–190 KG. Length: 170–250 CM.

story_description.en:
Asiatic Lion 1 is a mammal belonging to the Cats /  Felids group. 
It is found across Gujarat (Gir Forest), India, typically in Dry forests, scrublands, and grasslands. 
It feeds on Deer, antelope, wild cattle, and livestock and enjoys Open forests, grasslands, and areas with abundant prey., while avoiding Human disturbance and habitat loss.. 
This species measures around 170–250 CM and weighs approximately 110–190 KG. 
It lives up to 15-20 Years , with a gestation period of About 110 days and clutch size of 1–4 Cubs. 
Its conservation status is Endangered.
story_description.hi: एशियाई शेर 1 कैट्स/फेलिड्स समूह से संबंधित एक स्तनपायी है. यह पूरे गुजरात (गिर वन), भारत में पाया जाता है, आमतौर पर सूखे जंगलों, झाड़ियों और घास के मैदानों में. यह हिरण, मृग, जंगली मवेशियों और पशुओं को खाता है और खुले जंगलों, घास के मैदानों और प्रचुर शिकार वाले क्षेत्रों का आनंद लेता है।. , मानवीय अशांति और निवास स्थान के नुकसान से बचते हुए. इस प्रजाति की माप लगभग 170-250 सेमी और वजन लगभग 110-190 किलोग्राम है. यह 15-20 साल तक जीवित रहता है, गर्भधारण की अवधि लगभग 110 दिन और क्लच का आकार 1-4 शावकों का होता है।. इसकी संरक्षण स्थिति लुप्तप्राय है.

narrative.en: The Asiatic Lion is one of the most iconic animals of India. Once found across many parts of Asia, today it survives mainly in the Gir Forest of Gujarat thanks to strong conservation efforts.
narrative.hi: एशियाई शेर भारत के सबसे प्रतिष्ठित जानवरों में से एक है। कभी यह एशिया के कई हिस्सों में पाया जाता था, लेकिन आज यह मुख्य रूप से गुजरात के गिर वन में ही पाया जाता है, जहाँ संरक्षण प्रयासों से इसकी रक्षा की जा रही है।

Blackbuck (Leucistic) (Antilope cervicapra (Leucistic Morph)) is classified under Mammal. Description: Blackbuck (Leucistic) is a animal belonging to the Antelope and Bovid group. 
It is found across Occasionally found in India where rare white-colored blackbucks appear due to a genetic condition., typically in Open grasslands, dry plains, and agricultural fields.. 
It feeds on Grasses, leaves, crops, and plant pods. and enjoys Open plains with plenty of grass., while avoiding Predators and habitat disturbance.. 
This species measures around 100–150 CM and weighs approximately 20–40 KG. 
It lives up to 12–16 Years, with a gestation period of unknown and clutch size of unknown. 
Its conservation status is Least Concern .. Found in: India, Nepal, and reintroduced in Pakistan.. Likes: Open plains with plenty of grass.. Dislikes: Predators and habitat disturbance.. Fun facts: Leucistic Blackbucks have reduced pigmentation, giving them a stunning white-gold appearance — but their eyes remain dark. Weight: 20–40 KG. Length: 74–84 cm.

story_description.en:
Blackbuck (Leucistic) is a animal belonging to the Antelope and Bovid group. 
It is found across Occasionally found in India where rare white-colored blackbucks appear due to a genetic condition., typically in Open grasslands, dry plains, and agricultural fields.. 
It feeds on Grasses, leaves, crops, and plant pods. and enjoys Open plains with plenty of grass., while avoiding Predators and habitat disturbance.. 
This species measures around 100–150 CM and weighs approximately 20–40 KG. 
It lives up to 12–16 Years, with a gestation period of unknown and clutch size of unknown. 
Its conservation status is Least Concern .
story_description.hi:
काला हिरण (श्वेत रूप) एंटीलोप और बोविड (Antelope and Bovid) समूह का एक जानवर है।
यह भारत में कभी-कभी पाया जाता है, जहाँ दुर्लभ सफेद रंग के ब्लैकबक (Blackbuck) आनुवंशिक स्थिति के कारण देखे जाते हैं।

यह मुख्य रूप से खुले घास के मैदानों, शुष्क मैदानी क्षेत्रों और कृषि भूमि में रहता है।
यह घास, पत्तियाँ, फसलें और पौधों की फलियाँ खाता है तथा घास से भरपूर खुले मैदानों में रहना पसंद करता है, जबकि यह शिकारी जानवरों और आवास में होने वाले व्यवधान से बचता है।

इसकी लंबाई लगभग 100–150 सेमी और वजन लगभग 20–40 किलोग्राम होता है।
इसका जीवनकाल लगभग 12–16 वर्ष होता है, जबकि इसकी गर्भावधि और शावकों की संख्या के बारे में जानकारी उपलब्ध नहीं है।

इसकी संरक्षण स्थिति “Least Concern” मानी जाती है।

narrative.en:
Blackbuck (Leucistic) is a rare white-colored deer, often seen as a genetic variation of common deer species.
It is admired for its striking appearance and is usually found in forests, grasslands, or protected wildlife areas.
narrative.hi:
काला हिरण (श्वेत रूप) एक दुर्लभ सफेद रंग का हिरण है, जो सामान्य हिरण प्रजातियों का आनुवंशिक रूपांतरण माना जाता है।
यह अपने आकर्षक सफेद रंग के लिए जाना जाता है और आमतौर पर जंगलों, घासभूमियों और संरक्षित वन्य क्षेत्रों में पाया जाता है।

likes.en: Open plains with plenty of grass.
likes.hi: भरपूर घास वाले खुले मैदान।

dislikes.hi: शिकारी और निवास स्थान में अशांति।

threat_status.hi: कम से कम चिंता का विषय

fun_facts.en: Leucistic Blackbucks have reduced pigmentation, giving them a stunning white-gold appearance — but their eyes remain dark.
fun_facts.hi: ल्यूसिस्टिक काले हिरणों के शरीर में पिगमेंटेशन की कमी के कारण वे अद्भुत सफेद-सुनहरे दिखाई देते हैं, पर उनकी आंखों का रंग गहरा ही बना रहता है।

Common Fox (Indian Fox) (Vulpes bengalensis) is classified under Mammals. Description: Bengal Fox is a mammal belonging to the Canids /  Dog Family group. 
It is found across Found mainly in India, Nepal, and parts of Pakistan., typically in Open grasslands, semi-deserts, scrublands, and agricultural fields.. 
It feeds on Rodents, insects, small reptiles, birds, and fruits. and enjoys Open areas where it can easily hunt., while avoiding Habitat destruction and human disturbance.. 
This species measures around 45–60 CM and weighs approximately 2–4 KG. 
It lives up to 6–10 Years, with a gestation period of About 50–53 days and clutch size of 2–4 Pups. 
Its conservation status is Least Concern.. Found in: India, Nepal, Bangladesh and Pakistan.. Likes: Open areas where it can easily hunt.. Dislikes: Habitat destruction and human disturbance.. Fun facts: Foxes can hear small animals digging underground, using their super-sensitive hearing to pounce with precision. Weight: 2–4 KG. Length: 25–30 cm.

बंगाल फॉक्स (Bengal Fox) कैनिड्स / डॉग फैमिली समूह का एक स्तनधारी जानवर है।
यह मुख्य रूप से भारत, नेपाल और पाकिस्तान के कुछ हिस्सों में पाया जाता है और आमतौर पर खुले घास के मैदानों, अर्ध-रेगिस्तानी क्षेत्रों, झाड़ियों वाले इलाकों और कृषि भूमि में रहता है।

यह चूहे, कीड़े, छोटे सरीसृप, पक्षियों और फलों को खाता है तथा खुले क्षेत्रों में रहना पसंद करता है जहाँ यह आसानी से शिकार कर सके, जबकि यह आवास विनाश और मानव हस्तक्षेप से बचता है।

narrative.en: The Indian Fox is a small and agile wild fox native to the Indian subcontinent. It is recognized by its slender body, pointed muzzle, bushy tail with a black tip, and large ears. This intelligent animal is mostly active during dawn and dusk and is known for its quick movements and alert nature.
narrative.hi: भारतीय लोमड़ी एक छोटा और फुर्तीला जंगली लोमड़ी प्रजाति है, जो भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में पाई जाती है। इसकी पहचान इसके पतले शरीर, नुकीले चेहरे, काले सिरे वाली झबरीली पूंछ और बड़े कानों से होती है। यह बुद्धिमान जीव प्रायः सुबह और शाम के समय सक्रिय रहता है।

likes.en: Open areas where it can easily hunt.
likes.hi: खुले क्षेत्र जहां यह आसानी से शिकार कर सके।

dislikes.hi: पर्यावास का विनाश और मानवीय अशांति।

threat_status.hi: कम से कम चिंता का विषय

fun_facts.en: Foxes can hear small animals digging underground, using their super-sensitive hearing to pounce with precision.
fun_facts.hi: भारतीय लोमड़ी की सुनने की शक्ति बहुत तेज़ होती है। यह ज़मीन के नीचे चल रहे छोटे जानवरों की आहट भी सुन लेती है और सही जगह पर सटीक छलाँग लगाकर अपना शिकार पकड़ लेती है।

Black headed Ibis (Threskiornis melanocephalus) is classified under Birds. Description: Here we have the Black-headed Ibis, a remarkable bird from the Pelecaniformes group. 
Native to India, Sri Lanka, and Southeast Asia., it thrives in Marshes, shallow lakes, flooded fields, and coastal wetlands.. 
It spends its time feeding on Fish, frogs, insects, crustaceans, and other small aquatic animals. and enjoys Shallow water, open wetlands, but tends to avoid Pollution, habitat loss. 
With a size of  65–75 CM and weight of about 1.2–1.5 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 20 Years and is currently classified as not evaluated.. Found in: India, Sri Lanka, and Southeast Asia.. Likes: Shallow water, open wetlands. Dislikes: Pollution, habitat loss. Fun facts: The Black-headed Ibis uses its long, curved bill to probe soft mud and shallow water for food it cannot see. That long curved beak works like a food detector. Tap, find, and snack! Weight: 1.2–1.5 KG. Length: 65–75 CM.

story_description.hi: बंगाल मॉनिटर छिपकलियों और साँपों के समूह से संबंधित एक सरीसृप है. यह अफगानिस्तान, बांग्लादेश, कंबोडिया, चीन, म्यांमार, श्रीलंका, थाईलैंड, ईरान, वियतनाम, इंडोनेशिया, लाओ पीडीआर, भारत, पाकिस्तान, नेपाल और श्रीलंका में पाया जाता है।. , आमतौर पर जंगलों, रेगिस्तानों, घास के मैदानों और खेतों में. यह कीड़े, कृंतक, पक्षी, अंडे और मांस को खाता है. और ठंडे तापमान, निवास स्थान में गड़बड़ी और मानवीय हस्तक्षेप से बचते हुए गर्म धूप वाले क्षेत्रों, खुले आवासों, बिलों और जल स्रोतों का आनंद लेते हैं।. इस प्रजाति का माप लगभग 1-1 है. 5 मीटर और वजन लगभग 5-7 किलोग्राम. यह 10-15 साल तक जीवित रहती है, गर्भधारण की अवधि 6-9 महीने और अंडे देने का आकार 20-30 होता है।. इसके संरक्षण की स्थिति का मूल्यांकन नहीं किया जाता है.

narrative.en: The Bengal Monitor is a large, non-venomous lizard widely found in South Asia. It has a long neck, strong limbs, and a powerful tail. It is an excellent climber and digger, often seen basking in the sun. Despite its size, it is generally shy and avoids humans.
narrative.hi: गोह एक बड़ा, गैर-विषैला छिपकली प्रजाति है जो दक्षिण एशिया में पाई जाती है। इसका शरीर लंबा, पैर मजबूत और पूंछ शक्तिशाली होती है। यह पेड़ों पर चढ़ने और बिल खोदने में माहिर होता है और अक्सर धूप में आराम करते हुए देखा जाता है। यह आमतौर पर शर्मीला होता है और इंसानों से दूर रहता है।

dislikes.en: Cold temperatures, habitat disturbance, and human interference

story_audio.en: A giant lizard that uses its tongue to smell the air. They are excellent climbers and swimmers.
story_audio.hi: एक विशाल छिपकली जो अपनी जीभ से हवा सूंघती है। ये पेड़ पर चढ़ने और तैरने में माहिर होते हैं।

fun_facts.en: Their forked tongue and scent organs work like a chemical GPS, tracking prey with insane accuracy!
fun_facts.hi: उनकी दोमुंही जीभ और सूंघने वाले अंग रासायनिक जीपीएस की तरह काम करते हैं, जो शिकार का बेहद सटीकता से पता लगाते हैं!

fun_facts.en: Forked tongues help monitor lizards detect hidden prey and predators

narrative.en: The emu is a large flightless bird native to Australia and is the second-largest bird in the world after the ostrich. It has long powerful legs that help it run at high speeds across grasslands and open forests. Emus are curious and adaptable birds that feed on seeds, fruits, insects, and plants. Unlike many birds, the male emu incubates the eggs and raises the chicks after hatching.

Native to Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana,and Peru., it thrives in Tropical forests, and flooded woodlands.. 
It spends its time feeding on Fruits, seeds, berries, and insects. and enjoys Playing, climbing, social interaction, but tends to avoid Loneliness, lack of stimulation. 
With a size of 23 CM and weight of about 150–170 Grams, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 25–30 Years  and is currently classified as not evaluated.. Found in: Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana,and Peru.. Likes: Playing, climbing, social interaction. Dislikes: Loneliness, lack of stimulation. Fun facts: Caiques are known as the “acrobats of the parrot world”—hopping, rolling, and dancing when excited! They are known as the “clown parrots” because they constantly play and show off! When excited, they lie on their backs and wiggle — peak goofball mode! Weight: 150–170 Grams. Length: 23 CM.

Marsh Crocodile (Crocodylus palustris) is classified under Reptiles. Description: Marsh Crocodile is a reptile belonging to the Crocodilians group. 
It is found across India, Nepal, Iran, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka., typically in Freshwater lakes, rivers, marshes, and reservoirs.. 
It feeds on Fish, birds, small mammals, and amphibians. and enjoys Warm freshwater habitats and sunny riverbanks., while avoiding Pollution, habitat destruction, and human disturbance.. 
This species measures around 3–4 Meters and weighs approximately 300–450 KG. 
It lives up to 50–60 Years, with a gestation period of About 55–75 days and clutch size of 25–30 Eggs. 
Its conservation status is Vulnerable.. Found in: India, Nepal, Iran, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.. Likes: Warm freshwater habitats and sunny riverbanks.. Dislikes: Pollution, habitat destruction, and human disturbance.. Fun facts: Marsh crocodiles, commonly called muggers, are excellent swimmers but spend long hours basking in the sun to regulate their body temperature. As cold-blooded reptiles, sunlight powers their digestion, movement, and overall metabolism. Weight: 300–450 KG. Length: 3–4 Meters.

narrative.en: The marsh crocodile, also known as the mugger, is a broad-snouted crocodile commonly found in freshwater habitats like rivers, lakes, and marshes across India. It is an opportunistic predator that feeds on fish, birds, and mammals, playing an important role in maintaining ecosystem balance.
narrative.hi: दलदली मगरमच्छ, जिसे मग्गर भी कहा जाता है, चौड़े थूथन वाला मगरमच्छ है जो भारत में नदियों, झीलों और दलदली क्षेत्रों में पाया जाता है। यह एक अवसरवादी शिकारी है जो मछलियों, पक्षियों और स्तनधारियों का शिकार करता है और पारिस्थितिकी संतुलन बनाए रखने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है।

fun_facts.en: Marsh crocodiles, commonly called muggers, are excellent swimmers but spend long hours basking in the sun to regulate their body temperature. As cold-blooded reptiles, sunlight powers their digestion, movement, and overall metabolism.
fun_facts.hi: दलदली मगरमच्छ, जिन्हें आमतौर पर कहा जाता है, बेहतरीन तैराक होते हैं, लेकिन वे अपने शरीर के तापमान को नियंत्रित करने के लिए घंटों धूप सेंकते (basking) बिताते हैं। एक शीत-रक्त वाले (cold-blooded) सरीसृप होने के नाते, सूरज की रोशनी उनके पाचन, गतिशीलता और समग्र चयापचय (metabolism) को शक्ति प्रदान करती है।

Gharial Crocodilians (Gavialis gangeticus) is classified under Reptiles. Description: Here we have the Gharial, a remarkable reptile from the Crocodilians group. 
Native to Bangladesh, India and Nepal., it thrives in Deep, fast-flowing rivers with sandy banks.. 
It spends its time feeding on Primarily fish. and enjoys Clean rivers with plenty of fish and sandy nesting areas., but tends to avoid River pollution, dams, and habitat disturbance.. 
With a size of  4–6 Metres and weight of about 160–250 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 40–60 Years and is currently classified as Critically Endangered.. Found in: Bangladesh, India and Nepal.. Likes: Clean rivers with plenty of fish and sandy nesting areas.. Dislikes: River pollution, dams, and habitat disturbance.. Fun facts: Male gharials develop a bulbous structure called a “ghara” on the tip of their snout, which amplifies vocal sounds during courtship. Their narrow jaws hold over 100 sharp teeth designed for catching fish. That super-long thin snout is perfectly designed to snap fish at lightning speed — zero water resistance! Males grow a big round bump on the nose called a ghara that makes loud buzzing sounds to attract females! Weight: 160–250 KG. Length: 4–6 Metres.

story_description.hi: यहां हमारे पास घड़ियाल है, जो मगरमच्छ समूह का एक उल्लेखनीय सरीसृप है. बांग्लादेश, भारत और नेपाल के मूल निवासी. , यह रेतीले किनारों वाली गहरी, तेज़ बहने वाली नदियों में पनपता है. यह अपना समय मुख्यतः मछली खाकर व्यतीत करता है. और प्रचुर मात्रा में मछलियों और रेतीले घोंसले वाले क्षेत्रों के साथ स्वच्छ नदियों का आनंद लेता है. , लेकिन नदी प्रदूषण, बांधों और निवास स्थान में गड़बड़ी से बचने की प्रवृत्ति रखता है. 4-6 मीटर के आकार और लगभग 160-250 किलोग्राम वजन के साथ, यह अपने परिवेश के लिए अच्छी तरह से अनुकूलित है।. यह प्रजाति लगभग 40-60 वर्षों तक जीवित रहती है और वर्तमान में इसे गंभीर रूप से लुप्तप्राय के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है.

narrative.en: The gharial is a critically endangered crocodilian known for its long, narrow snout adapted for catching fish. It is mainly found in the rivers of the Indian subcontinent and plays a vital role in maintaining river ecosystems.

Indian Star Tortoise (Geochelone elegans) is classified under Reptiles. Description: Here we have the Indian Star Tortoise, a remarkable reptile from the Turtles and Tortoises group. 
Native to India, Sri Lanka, and Pakistan., it thrives in Dry scrub forests and grasslands. 
It spends its time feeding on Grasses, fruits, flowers, and leafy plants and enjoys Warm climate, dry areas, sunlight, but tends to avoid Cold weather and excessive moisture. 
With a size of 20–30 CM and weight of about 1–2.5 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 40–60 Years and is currently classified as  Vulnerable.. Found in: India, Sri Lanka, and Pakistan.. Likes: Warm climate, dry areas, sunlight. Dislikes: Cold weather and excessive moisture. Fun facts: Those star patterns aren’t just pretty -they help break up shadows, making the tortoise harder for predators to spot! It can survive long periods without drinking water. Unlike many tortoises, it is quite active during the day. Weight: 1–2.5 KG. Length: 20–30 CM.

Sika Deer (Cervus nippon) is classified under Mammal. Description: The Sika Deer gracefully moves through forests and grasslands. Its beautiful spotted coat helps it blend with sunlight filtering through trees. Known for its alert nature and gentle movements, this deer symbolizes the beauty and calmness of wild forests. 
It belongs to the Deer /  Carved group and is found in East Asia (China, Japan, Korea; and introduced worldwide)., mainly in Forests, grasslands, and shrublands.. 
Its diet consists of Leaves, grasses, fruits, and young shoots., and it prefers Dense forests, grassy areas, and quiet environments. while avoiding Loud noises, predators, and heavy human disturbance.. 
It measures about 70–110 CM and weighs around 35–70 KG. 
With a lifespan of 15–20 Years, gestation period of 210–230 days, and clutch size of 1 fawn, 
its conservation status is Least Concern.. Found in: East Asia (China, Japan, Korea; and introduced worldwide).. Likes: Dense forests, grassy areas, and quiet environments.. Dislikes: Loud noises, predators, and heavy human disturbance.. Fun facts: Sika deer can whistle. Males make loud, high-pitched calls during the mating season to attract females and warn rivals. They can trot silently through forests, making them excellent at avoiding predators. Weight: 35–70 KG. Length: 70–110 CM.

Siamese Crocodile (Crocodylus siamensis) is classified under Reptiles. Description: In the quiet wetlands of Southeast Asia, a Siamese crocodile lay silently near the riverbank. Its rough armored skin blended perfectly with the muddy water and plants around it. Patient and powerful, it waited for the right moment to catch fish swimming nearby. Though it looks fierce, this rare crocodile is an important part of the wetland ecosystem and needs protection to survive for future generations. 
It belongs to the Crocodilians group and is found in Cambodia, Laos, Thailand, and Vietnam (now highly fragmented)., mainly in Slow-moving rivers, marshes, swamps, and freshwater wetlands.. 
Its diet consists of Fish, amphibians, crustaceans, and small mammals., and it prefers Calm freshwater habitats with plenty of fish. while avoiding Habitat destruction and water pollution.. 
It measures about 2–3 Meter and weighs around 40–150 KG. 
With a lifespan of 50–70 Years, gestation period of About 70–80 days, and clutch size of 20–50 Eggs, 
its conservation status is Critically Endangered.. Found in: Cambodia, Laos, Thailand, and Vietnam (now highly fragmented).. Likes: Calm freshwater habitats with plenty of fish.. Dislikes: Habitat destruction and water pollution.. Fun facts: They can replace their teeth up to 4,000 times in a lifetime—a truly unlimited tooth hack! Crocodiles can hold their breath for over an hour by slowing their heart to just a few beats per minute! They can replace their teeth up to 4,000 times in a lifetime, unlimited tooth hack! Weight: 40–150 KG. Length: 2–3 Meter.

story_description.hi:
दक्षिण पूर्व एशिया के शांत आर्द्रभूमि में, एक स्याम देश का मगरमच्छ नदी के किनारे चुपचाप लेटा हुआ था. इसकी खुरदरी बख्तरबंद त्वचा गंदे पानी और इसके आस-पास के पौधों के साथ पूरी तरह मिश्रित हो गई. धैर्यवान और शक्तिशाली, वह पास में तैर रही मछलियों को पकड़ने के लिए सही समय का इंतजार कर रहा था. यद्यपि यह भयंकर दिखता है, यह दुर्लभ मगरमच्छ आर्द्रभूमि पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा है और इसे भविष्य की पीढ़ियों के लिए जीवित रहने के लिए संरक्षण की आवश्यकता है. यह मगरमच्छ समूह से संबंधित है और कंबोडिया, लाओस, थाईलैंड और वियतनाम (अब अत्यधिक खंडित) में पाया जाता है।. , मुख्य रूप से धीमी गति से बहने वाली नदियों, दलदलों, दलदलों और मीठे पानी की आर्द्रभूमियों में. इसके आहार में मछली, उभयचर, क्रस्टेशियंस और छोटे स्तनधारी शामिल हैं. , और यह प्रचुर मात्रा में मछलियों के साथ शांत मीठे पानी के आवासों को पसंद करता है. पर्यावास विनाश और जल प्रदूषण से बचते हुए. इसका माप लगभग 2-3 मीटर और वजन लगभग 40-150 किलोग्राम होता है. 50-70 वर्ष का जीवनकाल, लगभग 70-80 दिनों की गर्भधारण अवधि, और 20-50 अंडों के क्लच आकार के साथ, 
.

Red Eared Slider (Trachemys scripta elegans) is classified under Mammals. Description: Here we have the Red Eared Slider, a remarkable mammal from the Turtles and Tortoises group. 
Native to Mexico and United States of America, and introduced worldwide, it thrives in Lakes, ponds, rivers, and marshes with basking sites.. 
It spends its time feeding on Omnivore — aquatic plants, insects, fish, and tadpoles. and enjoys Warm water, basking in sunlight, aquatic vegetation, but tends to avoid Cold temperatures and polluted water. 
With a size of 15–28 CM and weight of about 1–2.5 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 20–30 Years  and is currently classified as Least Concern.. Found in: Mexico and United States of America, and introduced worldwide.. Likes: Warm water, basking in sunlight, aquatic vegetation. Dislikes: Cold temperatures and polluted water. Fun facts: They can slow their metabolism massively to survive months with almost no oxygen! [object Object] Weight: 1–2.5 KG. Length: 15–28 CM.

Indian muntjac(Barking Deer) (Muntiacus muntjak) is classified under Mammals. Description: Here we have the Indian muntjac(Barking Deer) 1, a remarkable mammal from the Deer /  Carved group. 
Native to India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Pakistan, China, Sri Lanka, and across Southeast Asia., it thrives in Dense forests, foothill regions, and areas with thick vegetation.. 
It spends its time feeding on  Leaves, tender shoots, and fruits. and enjoys Dense forest cover, quiet habitats, and areas with plenty of vegetation., but tends to avoid Human disturbance and habitat loss.. 
With a size of 40 – 65 CM and weight of about 15 – 30 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 10 – 15 Years and is currently classified as Least Concern.. Found in: India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Pakistan, China, Sri Lanka, and across Southeast Asia.. Likes: Dense forest cover, quiet habitats, and areas with plenty of vegetation.. Dislikes: Human disturbance and habitat loss.. Fun facts: Indian muntjacs emit a loud barking call, similar to that of a dog, as an alarm signal — earning them the nickname “barking deer.” [object Object] Weight: 15 – 30 KG. Length: 40 – 65 CM.

Red Sand Boa (Eryx johnii) is classified under Reptiles. Description: Red Sand Boa is a reptile belonging to the Lizards and snakes group. 
It is found across India, Pakistan, Iran, Afghanistan, and Nepal., typically in Dry scrublands, semi-deserts, grasslands, and agricultural fields.. 
It feeds on Rodents, small birds, lizards, and other snakes. and enjoys Loose sandy soil, warm climate, and underground burrows, while avoiding Cold weather and disturbance. 
This species measures around 60–90 CM and weighs approximately 1–2 KG. 
It lives up to 12–20 Years, with a gestation period of 4–5 months and clutch size of  3–14 young. 
Its conservation status is not evaluated.. Found in: India, Pakistan, Iran, Afghanistan, and Nepal.. Likes: Loose sandy soil, warm climate, and underground burrows. Dislikes: Cold weather and disturbance. Fun facts: The red sand boa’s blunt, rounded tail closely resembles its head, a defensive mimicry that diverts predator attacks away from the real head. It spends most of its life hidden under the soil. Weight: 1–2 KG. Length: 60–90 CM.

Red and Blue Macaw (Ara macao) is classified under Bird. Description: The Red & Blue Macaw is one of the most colorful parrots in the world. Its bright red body and blue wings make it easy to identify from far away. 
It belongs to the Parrots, Parakeets and Macaws group and is found in Central and South America, including Mexico, Brazil, Peru, and Bolivia, mainly in Tropical rainforests, humid evergreen forests, and woodland edges. 
Its diet consists of Fruits, nuts, seeds, berries, and leaves, and it prefers Fruits, tree hollows, flocking, climbing while avoiding Habitat loss, illegal pet trade, loud disturbance.

Painted Stork (Mycteria leucocephala) is classified under Birds. Description: Here we have the Painted Stork, a remarkable bird from the Pelecaniformes group. 
Native to  India, Sri Lanka, and Southeast Asia., it thrives in Wetlands, shallow lakes, marshes, and riverbanks.. 
It spends its time feeding on Primarily fish; also feeds on frogs, insects, and other small aquatic animals. and enjoys Shallow water, abundant fish, nesting in colonies on tall trees., but tends to avoid Disturbance, pollution, habitat destruction.. 
With a size of  95–100 CM and weight of about  2–3.5 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 28–30 Years and is currently classified as Near Threatened.. Found in: India, Sri Lanka, and Southeast Asia.. Likes: Shallow water, abundant fish, nesting in colonies on tall trees.. Dislikes: Disturbance, pollution, habitat destruction.. Fun facts: The Painted Stork gets its name from the pink-washed feathers on its wings, which give the appearance of being lightly brushed with paint. Its wings look hand-painted,nature’s own artwork! They can stand on one leg for hours like a yoga expert! Weight: 2–3.5 KG. Length: 95–100 CM.

Dislikes: Deforestation, habitat loss, hunting. Lion Tailed Macaque (Macaca silenus) is classified under Mammal. Description: High in the lush forests of the Western Ghats, a lion-tailed macaque moved gracefully through the tree branches. Its shiny black fur and silver mane made it look like a tiny forest king. The monkey carefully searched for fruits and insects among the leaves while keeping watch for danger. Though rare and shy, the lion-tailed macaque plays an important role in spreading seeds and keeping the rainforest alive. 
It belongs to the unknown group group and is found in Endemic to the Western Ghats of India., mainly in  Tropical rainforests.. 
Its diet consists of  Fruits, shoots, insects, and small vertebrates., and it prefers Dense forest canopy and areas with abundant fruits. while avoiding Deforestation and human disturbance.. 
It measures about 45–60 CM and weighs around 2–10 KG. 
With a lifespan of  20–30 Years, gestation period of 170 days, and clutch size of 1 Infant, 
its conservation status is Endangered.. Found in: Endemic to the Western Ghats of India. Likes: Dense forest canopy and areas with abundant fruits.. Dislikes: Deforestation and human disturbance.. Fun facts: Their striking black coat, silver-white mane, and tufted tail give them a unique appearance. Scientists call them a forest health indicator, if they are gone, the forest is in trouble! It’s one of the shyest monkeys in India, rare to spot in the wild! Weight: 2–10 KG. Length: 45–60 CM.

story_description.en:
High in the lush forests of the Western Ghats, a lion-tailed macaque moved gracefully through the tree branches. Its shiny black fur and silver mane made it look like a tiny forest king. The monkey carefully searched for fruits and insects among the leaves while keeping watch for danger. Though rare and shy, the lion-tailed macaque plays an important role in spreading seeds and keeping the rainforest alive. 
It belongs to the unknown group group and is found in Endemic to the Western Ghats of India., mainly in  Tropical rainforests.. 
Its diet consists of  Fruits, shoots, insects, and small vertebrates., and it prefers Dense forest canopy and areas with abundant fruits. while avoiding Deforestation and human disturbance.. 
It measures about 45–60 CM and weighs around 2–10 KG. 
With a lifespan of  20–30 Years, gestation period of 170 days, and clutch size of 1 Infant, 
its conservation status is Endangered.

narrative.en: The Lion-tailed Macaque is a rare and endangered monkey found only in the Western Ghats of India. It is easily recognized by its black body, silver-white mane around the face, and tail ending in a tuft like a lion’s tail. These intelligent primates spend most of their lives in trees.
narrative.hi: शेर पूंछ वानर भारत के पश्चिमी घाट में पाया जाने वाला एक दुर्लभ और संकटग्रस्त बंदर है। इसकी पहचान इसके काले शरीर, चेहरे के आसपास चांदी-सफेद अयाल और शेर जैसी गुच्छेदार पूंछ से होती है। यह बुद्धिमान प्राइमेट अपना अधिकांश जीवन पेड़ों पर बिताता है।

likes.en: Dense forest canopy and areas with abundant fruits.

dislikes.hi: वनों की कटाई और मानव अशांति.

fun_facts.en: Scientists call them a forest health indicator, if they are gone, the forest is in trouble!

Knob billed Duck (Sarkidiornis melanotos) is classified under Birds. Description: The Knob-billed Duck is a large waterfowl known for the prominent black knob on the bill of adult males. It has a glossy greenish-black head and white body. This species is often seen in wetlands and open water bodies and is known for its strong flight. 
It belongs to the Goose, Ducks and Swan group and is found in India, Africa, and Southeast Asia., mainly in Wetlands, floodplains, lakes, and slow-moving rivers.. 
Its diet consists of Seeds, aquatic plants, grasses, and small insects., and it prefers Open water bodies, wetlands while avoiding Habitat disturbance, pollution. 
It measures about  56–76 CM and weighs around 1.5–3 KG. 
With a lifespan of 15–20 Years, gestation period of 28–30 days, and clutch size of  7–15 Eggs, 
its conservation status is not evaluated.. Found in: India, Africa, and Southeast Asia.. Likes: Open water bodies, wetlands. Dislikes: Habitat disturbance, pollution. Fun facts: Male Knob-billed Ducks develop a large black knob on their bill during the breeding season. This feature is used to attract females and becomes less prominent outside the breeding period. This knob gets bigger during the breeding season to impress females Weight: 1.5–3 KG. Length: 56–76 CM.

Khalij Pheasant (Lophura leucomelanos) is classified under Bird. Description: Khalij Pheasant 2 is a animal belonging to the Francolins and Pheasants group. 
It is found across Himalayan foothills of India, Nepal, and Bhutan., typically in  Oak-pine forests, scrublands and steep hilly slopes.. 
It feeds on Seeds, berries, insects, and shoots. and enjoys Dense shrubs, forest floor, seeds, insects, while avoiding Habitat loss, hunting, human disturbance. 
This species measures around 50–70 CM and weighs approximately 1–1.3 KG. 
It lives up to 12–15 Years, with a gestation period of 24–25 days and clutch size of 5–9 Eggs. 
Its conservation status is Least Concern... Found in: Himalayan foothills of India, Nepal, and Bhutan.. Likes: Dense shrubs, forest floor, seeds, insects. Dislikes: Habitat loss, hunting, human disturbance. Fun facts: Male Kalij pheasants are much more colorful than females. They prefer running on the ground rather than flying. Black Francolins are adept runners and often evade predators on foot—relying on their speed and hiding spots—rather than taking flight! Weight: 1–1.3 KG. Length: 50–70 CM.

Indian Grey Hornbill (Ocyceros birostris) is classified under Bird. Description: The Asian Grey Hornbill is known for its long curved bill and loud calls. It helps forests grow by spreading seeds after eating fruits. 
It belongs to the unknown group group and is found in India, Nepal, Pakistan, and Bangladesh., mainly in Dry deciduous forests, open woodlands, and urban parks with mature trees.. 
Its diet consists of Fruits, insects, and small reptiles., and it prefers Fruit trees, tall hollow trees, figs, forest canopy while avoiding Tree cutting, habitat loss, nest disturbance. 
It measures about 60–65 cm and weighs around 400–600 g. 
With a lifespan of 15–20 years, gestation period of 25–30 days, and clutch size of 2–4 eggs, 
its conservation status is Least Concern .. Found in: India, Nepal, Pakistan, and Bangladesh.. Likes: Fruit trees, tall hollow trees, figs, forest canopy. Dislikes: Tree cutting, habitat loss, nest disturbance. Fun facts: Female Indian grey hornbills seal themselves inside tree cavities during nesting, leaving only a small slit for the male to feed them. Their large casque on the beak helps amplify their calls across dense forests. Its long and curved beak works like a built-in fruit grabber, a snack master! Weight: 400–600 g. Length: 60–65 cm.

It belongs to the unknown group group and is found in India, Nepal, Pakistan, and Bangladesh., mainly in Dry deciduous forests, open woodlands, and urban parks with mature trees.. 
Its diet consists of Fruits, insects, and small reptiles., and it prefers Fruit trees, tall hollow trees, figs, forest canopy while avoiding Tree cutting, habitat loss, nest disturbance. 
It measures about 60–65 cm and weighs around 400–600 g. 
With a lifespan of 15–20 years, gestation period of 25–30 days, and clutch size of 2–4 eggs, 
its conservation status is Least Concern .

.

Golden Pheasant (Chrysolophus pictus) is classified under Bird. Description: Here we have the Golden Pheasant, a remarkable animal from the Francolins and Pheasants group. 
Native to China (introduced in parts of Europe and North America)., it thrives in  Forests, bamboo thickets, and mountainous woodlands.. 
It spends its time feeding on Seeds, berries, shoots, and insects and enjoys Dense vegetation, forest cover, quiet areas, but tends to avoid Habitat loss, hunting, loud disturbance. 
With a size of 90–105 CM and weight of about 550–700 Gram, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 10–15 Years and is currently classified as Least Concern.. Found in: China (introduced in parts of Europe and North America).. Likes: Dense vegetation, forest cover, quiet areas. Dislikes: Habitat loss, hunting, loud disturbance. Fun facts: Golden pheasants are known for their dazzling red, gold, and blue plumage, making them one of the most colourful birds in the world. The female are cryptic and brownish in colour as compared to the flashier males, this protects the females from predators when they are nesting on the ground! Weight: 550–700 Gram. Length: 90–105 CM.

Its diet consists of Seeds, fruits, grains, nuts, vegetables, and buds, and it prefers Fruits, seeds, climbing branches, social interaction while avoiding Loud disturbance, isolation, cage stress. 
It measures about 38–42 CM and weighs around 110–140 Gram. 
With a lifespan of 20–30 Years, gestation period of unknown, and clutch size of unknown, 
its conservation status is Least Concern.. Found in: Captive populations worldwide original species native to India, Africa, and South Asia. story_description.hi:
रंग-बिरंगे म्यूटेशन वाले तोते (Colour Mutation Parakeet) को उसके अनोखे रंगों जैसे नीले, पीले, सफ़ेद और चितकबरे (pied) पैटर्न के लिए पसंद किया जाता है। ये खूबसूरत रंग प्राकृतिक या चुनिंदा जेनेटिक म्यूटेशन (आनुवंशिक बदलावों) से बनते हैं।
यह तोते, पैराकीट और मैकाऊ समूह से संबंधित है और दुनिया भर में पालतू आबादी में पाया जाता है; इसकी मूल प्रजाति भारत, अफ्रीका और दक्षिण एशिया की मूल निवासी है, और यह मुख्य रूप से पक्षीशालाओं (Aviaries), चिड़ियाघर के बाड़ों, बगीचों, शहरी पार्कों और जंगलों में पाया जाता है।
इसके भोजन में बीज, फल, अनाज, मेवे, सब्जियां और कलियां शामिल होती हैं; इसे फल, बीज, चढ़ने के लिए डालियां और सामाजिक मेलजोल पसंद है, जबकि यह तेज़ शोर-शराबे, अकेलेपन और पिंजरे के तनाव से दूर रहना पसंद करता है।
इसका आकार लगभग 38–42 सेंटीमीटर होता है और इसका वज़न लगभग 110–140 ग्राम होता है।
इसकी जीवन अवधि 20–30 वर्ष होती है, इसका गर्भकाल अज्ञात है, और इसके अंडों की संख्या (clutch size) भी अज्ञात है।
इसके संरक्षण की स्थिति 'सबसे कम चिंताजनक' (Least Concern) है।

narrative.en: The Colour Mutation Parakeet is admired for its unique shades like blue, yellow, white, and pied patterns. These beautiful colors are created by natural or selective genetic mutations.
narrative.hi:
रंग बिरंगा तोता अपने आकर्षक रंगों जैसे नीला, पीला, सफेद और विभिन्न पाइड पैटर्न के लिए जाना जाता है।
इन सुंदर रंगों का निर्माण प्राकृतिक या चयनात्मक आनुवंशिक परिवर्तन (genetic mutations) के कारण होता है।

It is found across India, Southeast Asia, and Australia., typically in Coastal regions, wetlands, estuaries, and riverbanks.. 
It feeds on Fish, crabs, carrion, and other small prey. and enjoys Fish, open water bodies, tall trees for nesting, while avoiding Habitat destruction, water pollution, disturbance near nests. 
This species measures around 45–55 CM and weighs approximately 600-1000+KG. 
It lives up to 15–20 Years, with a gestation period of 28–35 days and clutch size of 1–2 Eggs. 
Its conservation status is Least Concern.. Found in: India, Southeast Asia, and Australia.. Likes: Fish, open water bodies, tall trees for nesting. Dislikes: Habitat destruction, water pollution, disturbance near nests. Fun facts: Instead of always hunting live prey, Brahminy kites are opportunistic feeders—they often steal food from other birds or scavenge, making them clever survivors in busy habitats This striking bird is often referred to as the “Shiva’s Kite” in India and is admired for its graceful, soaring flights over rivers and coastlines. Weight: 600-1000 G. Length: 45–55 CM.

Black Partridge (Melanoperdix niger) is classified under Birds. Description: Here we have the Black Partridge, a remarkable bird from the Francolins and Pheasants group. 
Native to Southeast Asia, it thrives in Dense lowland forests and thick undergrowth.. 
It spends its time feeding on Seeds, insects, and young plant shoots. and enjoys Tall grass, grains, insects, open scrub, but tends to avoid Habitat destruction, hunting, loud disturbance. 
With a size of 26–30 CM and weight of about 250–300 Gram, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 8–12 Years and is currently classified as Least Concern .. Found in: Southeast Asia. Likes: Tall grass, grains, insects, open scrub. Dislikes: Habitat destruction, hunting, loud disturbance. Fun facts: Black partridges are mostly shy and secretive, preferring to move silently through dense undergrowth. They usually walk or run instead of flying, making them stealthy little forest ninjas The Black Partridge has dark plumage that helps it blend into the shaded forest floor. This camouflage makes it difficult for predators to spot among leaves and undergrowth Weight: 250–300 Gram. Length: 26–30 CM.

Bare eyed Cockatoo (Cacatua sanguinea) is classified under Birds. Description: The Bare-eyed Cockatoo is a highly social and intelligent bird. It is famous for its playful behavior, loud calls, and clown-like personality. 
It belongs to the Parrots, Parakeets and Macaws group and is found in Australia and southern Papua New Guinea., mainly in Woodlands, grasslands, farmlands, and urban areas. 
Its diet consists of Seeds, grains, fruits, roots, and occasionally insects., and it prefers Social flocks, tree hollows, seeds, bathing while avoiding Isolation, loud disturbance, habitat destruction. 
It measures about 35–40 CM and weighs around 500 Gram. 
With a lifespan of 40–60 Years, gestation period of 26–30 days, and clutch size of  2–3 Eggs, 
its conservation status is Least Concern .. Found in: Australia and southern Papua New Guinea.. Likes: Social flocks, tree hollows, seeds, bathing. Dislikes: Isolation, loud disturbance, habitat destruction. Fun facts: They  are very intelligent and known for their ability for vocal mimicry, problem solving and tool use! These cockatoos have a bare blue ring around their eyes, giving them a permanently curious expression. Weight: 500 Gram. Length: 35–40 CM.

Native to India, Sri Lanka, Nepal; and introduced worldwide., it thrives in  Forest edges, farmlands, scrublands, and open woodland areas.. 
It spends its time feeding on Seeds, grains and insects. and enjoys Open fields, trees, grains, insects, and water sources, but tends to avoid Habitat loss, hunting, loud disturbance. 
With a size of  Up to 2.2 Meters and weight of about 4–6 kg, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around  20–25 years and is currently classified as Least Concern .. Found in: India, Sri Lanka, Nepal; and introduced worldwide.. Likes: Open fields, trees, grains, insects, and water sources. Dislikes: Habitat loss, hunting, loud disturbance. Fun facts: These white peafowls are not albino — they have normal eye color! Their snowy plumage is caused by a rare genetic variation called leucism They can still display colorful eyespots, but they appear white. Weight: 4–6 kg. Length: Up to 2.2 Meters.

story_description.hi:
हेरोनरी (Heronry) एक जीवित घोंसला कॉलोनी है, जहाँ प्रजनन के मौसम में दर्जनों या सैकड़ों जल पक्षी एक साथ घोंसला बनाने के लिए इकट्ठा होते हैं।
सुबह से शाम तक पेड़ों में लगातार गतिविधि रहती है, जहाँ पक्षी टहनियाँ लाते हैं, अपने घोंसलों की रक्षा करते हैं और अपने बच्चों को भोजन कराते हैं।

यह किसी एक जानवर का नहीं, बल्कि बगुले और अन्य जल पक्षियों की कॉलोनी होती है, जो दुनिया के कई हिस्सों में आर्द्रभूमि, झीलों, नदियों, मैंग्रोव और बड़े पेड़ों के पास पाई जाती है।
यह मुख्य रूप से जल निकायों के पास ऊँचे पेड़ों में बनती है, जैसे झीलें, तालाब, आर्द्रभूमि और नदियाँ।

इसका भोजन मछलियाँ, मेंढक, कीड़े और छोटे जलीय जीव होते हैं (प्रजाति के अनुसार अलग-अलग)।
इसे ऊँचे पेड़, आर्द्रभूमि और शांत घोंसला क्षेत्र पसंद होते हैं, जबकि यह पेड़ों की कटाई, मानवीय हस्तक्षेप और आवास विनाश से बचता है।

इसका आकार और वजन प्रजाति के अनुसार अलग-अलग होता है।
इसका जीवनकाल लगभग 10–20 वर्ष होता है, अंडों की संख्या लगभग 2–5 होती है (प्रजाति के अनुसार भिन्न), और इसकी संरक्षण स्थिति “Least Concern” मानी जाती है।

nodes.description:
Indian Rhinoceros (Greater One Horned Rhinoceros) (Rhinoceros unicornis) is classified under Mammal. Description: Here we have the Indian Rhinoceros (Greater One-Horned Rhinoceros), a remarkable animal from the Rhino group. 
Native to India and Nepal., it thrives in Grasslands, floodplains, and swampy forests.. 
It spends its time feeding on Grasses, leaves, and aquatic plants. and enjoys Areas with water, mud wallows, and tall grasses., but tends to avoid Human disturbance and habitat loss.. 
With a size of 1.7–2.0 Meters and weight of about 1,800–2,500 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 35–45 Years and is currently classified as Vulnerable.. Found in: India and Nepal.. Likes: Areas with water, mud wallows, and tall grasses.. Dislikes: Human disturbance and habitat loss.. Fun facts: The Indian rhinoceros has thick, folded skin that resembles a suit of armor — but the skin is surprisingly soft between the folds. Its skin folds looks like natural body armour plates, they are the only rhinoceros species to have that! Birds ride on its back like a living cleaning station, free parasite removal service! Weight: 1,800–2,500 KG. Length: 1.7–2.0 Meters.

narrative.en:
The Indian Rhinoceros, also known as the Greater One-horned Rhino, is a massive herbivore recognized for its single horn and thick armor-like skin.
It is mainly found in the grasslands and wetlands of India and Nepal, where it feeds on grasses, fruits, and aquatic plants.

भारतीय गैंडा, जिसे ग्रेटर वन-हॉर्न्ड राइनो भी कहा जाता है, एक विशाल शाकाहारी जीव है जो अपने एक सींग और कवच जैसी मोटी त्वचा के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
यह मुख्यतः भारत और नेपाल के घास के मैदानों और आर्द्रभूमियों में पाया जाता है तथा घास, फल और जलीय पौधों का भोजन करता है।

Asian Palm Civet (Paradoxurus hermaphroditus) is classified under Mammal. Description: Here we have the Asian Palm Civet, a remarkable animal from the Civets / Viverrids group. 
Native to  India and parts of Southeast Asia., it thrives in Tropical forests, agricultural plantations, and urban areas.. 
It spends its time feeding on Fruits, insects, small vertebrates, and nectar. and enjoys Dense vegetation, fruiting trees, and quiet forest areas., but tends to avoid Deforestation and heavy human disturbance.. 
With a size of 40–70 CM and weight of about 2–5 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around  15–20 Years and is currently classified as Least Concern.. Found in: India and parts of Southeast Asia.. Likes: Dense vegetation, fruiting trees, and quiet forest areas.. Dislikes: Deforestation and heavy human disturbance.. Fun facts: They are nicknamed the toddy cat but they are not cats, they are more closely related to mongooses and weasels. Civets help forests grow. They spread seeds from the fruits they eat, acting as natural gardeners. Weight: 2–5 KG. Length: 40–70 CM.

Alexandrine Parakeet (Psittacula eupatria) is classified under Birds. Description: Here we have the Alexandrine Parakeet 2, a remarkable bird from the Parrots, Parakeets and Macaws group. 
Native to India, Sri Lanka, and Southeast Asia, it thrives in Forests, plantations, urban parks. 
It spends its time feeding on  Fruits, seeds, nuts and enjoys Trees, fruits, open spaces, and social interaction, but tends to avoid Habitat loss and disturbance. 
With a size of  58–62 CM and weight of about 200–260 Gram, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 30–40 Years and is currently classified as not evaluated.. Found in: India, Sri Lanka, and Southeast Asia. Likes: Trees, fruits, open spaces, and social interaction. Dislikes: Habitat loss and disturbance. Fun facts: Alexandrine parakeets are named after Alexander the Great, who is believed to have brought them to Europe. They are super social — always hanging out in noisy green gangs and mimic human words clearly. [object Object] Weight: 200–260 Gram. Length: 58–62 CM.

It belongs to the unknown group group and is found in  Northeast of India, Bangladesh, China and parts of Southeast Asia., mainly in Dense forests and hilly terrain..

its conservation status is Vulnerable.. Found in: Northeast of India, Bangladesh, China and parts of Southeast Asia. Spectacled Cobra (Naja naja) is classified under Reptiles. Description: The spectacled cobra is one of the most well-known venomous snakes in India, recognized by the distinctive spectacle-like mark on its hood. It is often associated with Indian culture and is commonly found in a variety of habitats. 
It belongs to the unknown group group and is found in India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan and Nepal., mainly in Farms, forests, grasslands, and human settlements.. 
Its diet consists of Rodents, frogs, lizards, and other snakes., and it prefers Warm environments, shelter, and abundant prey while avoiding Cold weather and disturbance. 
It measures about 1.2–1.8 Meters and weighs around 1–2 KG. 
With a lifespan of 15–20 Years, gestation period of 48–70 days, and clutch size of 10–30 Eggs, 
its conservation status is not evaluated.. Found in: India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan and Nepal.. Likes: Warm environments, shelter, and abundant prey. Dislikes: Cold weather and disturbance. Fun facts: The cobra’s hood bears markings resembling spectacles, serving as a warning signal to predators. Cobras can control how much venom they inject — sometimes delivering “dry bites” with zero venom! Some cobras remember threats and avoid the same humans later — reptile memory is real! Weight: 1–2 KG. Length: 1.2–1.8 Meters.

story_description.hi:
नाग भारत के सबसे प्रसिद्ध विषैले साँपों में से एक है, जिसे इसके फन पर बने विशिष्ट चश्मे जैसे निशान से पहचाना जाता है। यह भारतीय संस्कृति से भी जुड़ा हुआ है और विभिन्न प्रकार के आवासों में आमतौर पर पाया जाता है।

यह साँप (Snakes) समूह से संबंधित है और भारत, पाकिस्तान, श्रीलंका, बांग्लादेश, भूटान और नेपाल में पाया जाता है, विशेष रूप से खेतों, जंगलों, घास के मैदानों और मानव बस्तियों में।

इसका आहार मुख्यतः कृंतक (चूहे), मेंढक, छिपकलियाँ और अन्य साँप होते हैं। यह गर्म वातावरण, आश्रय और पर्याप्त शिकार को पसंद करता है, जबकि ठंडे मौसम और व्यवधान से बचता है।

इसकी लंबाई लगभग 1.2–1.8 मीटर होती है और वजन लगभग 1–2 किलोग्राम होता है।

इसका जीवनकाल लगभग 15–20 वर्ष होता है, गर्भावधि अवधि 48–70 दिन होती है, और मादा एक बार में 10–30 अंडे देती है।

इसकी संरक्षण स्थिति (Conservation Status) अभी मूल्यांकित नहीं की गई है।

story_description.hi:
स्मूथ कोटेड ओटर (Smooth Coated Otter) ऊदबिलाव / मस्टेलिड (Otter / Mustelid) समूह का एक जानवर है।
यह दक्षिण और दक्षिण-पूर्व एशिया में पाया जाता है, जिसमें भारत, नेपाल, बांग्लादेश, श्रीलंका और अन्य क्षेत्र शामिल हैं, और मुख्य रूप से नदियों, झीलों, आर्द्रभूमियों, मैंग्रोव और तटीय क्षेत्रों में रहता है।

यह मुख्य रूप से मछलियों, केकड़ों, मेंढकों और छोटे जलीय जीवों को खाता है तथा साफ जल स्रोत, नदी किनारे और मछलियों से भरपूर क्षेत्रों में रहना पसंद करता है, जबकि यह जल प्रदूषण, आवास विनाश और मानवीय हस्तक्षेप से बचता है।

इसकी लंबाई लगभग 100–130 सेमी और वजन लगभग 7–11 किलोग्राम होता है।
इसका जीवनकाल लगभग 10–12 वर्ष होता है, जबकि इसकी गर्भावधि और शावकों की संख्या के बारे में जानकारी उपलब्ध नहीं है।

इसकी संरक्षण स्थिति “Vulnerable” मानी जाती है।

narrative.en: The smooth-coated otter is an excellent swimmer and a playful animal that spends much of its time in water. Living in family groups, they hunt fish together and communicate using whistles and chirps.
narrative.hi: ऊदबिलाव एक उत्कृष्ट तैराक और चंचल जानवर है जो अपना अधिकांश समय पानी में बिताता है। ये परिवार के समूहों में रहते हैं और मिलकर मछलियों का शिकार करते हैं तथा सीटी और चहचहाहट जैसी आवाज़ों से संवाद करते हैं।

likes.hi: स्वच्छ जल निकाय, नदी तट और मछली से समृद्ध क्षेत्र।

dislikes.en: Water pollution, habitat destruction, and disturbance.

fun_facts.hi: चिकनी परत वाले ऊदबिलाव "राफ्ट" नामक पारिवारिक समूहों में रहते हैं और सहयोगपूर्वक शिकार करते हैं।

Small Indian Civet (Viverricula indica) is classified under Mammal. Description: Here we have the Small Indian Civet, a remarkable animal from the Civets / Viverrids group. 
Native to India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cambodia, China, Sri Lanka, Thailand Vietnam, Myanmar, Nepal, and other parts of South east  Asia., it thrives in Forests, plantations, and grasslands.. 
It spends its time feeding on Birds, insects, rodents, and fruits. and enjoys Dense vegetation, hiding places, and areas with abundant food., but tends to avoid Habitat destruction and human disturbance.. 
With a size of 30–45 CM and weight of about 2–4 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 10–15 Years and is currently classified as Least Concern.. Found in: India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cambodia, China, Sri Lanka, Thailand Vietnam, Myanmar, Nepal, and other parts of South east  Asia.. Likes: Dense vegetation, hiding places, and areas with abundant food.. Dislikes: Habitat destruction and human disturbance.. Fun facts: Small Indian civets play an important role in controlling rodent populations and dispersing seeds. It hunts quietly through the night and uses its strong nose to sniff out food and avoid trouble! Weight: 2–4 KG. Length: 30–45 CM.

Sloth Bear (Melursus ursinus) is classified under Mammals. Description: Here we have the Sloth Bear, a remarkable mammal from the Bears / Ursids group. 
Native to India, Nepal, and Sri Lanka, it thrives in Dry forests, shrubland, and grasslands. 
It spends its time feeding on Termites, ants, fruits, and honey and enjoys Forest areas with termite mounds, fruits, and water sources., but tends to avoid Habitat destruction and human disturbance.. 
With a size of 60–90 CM and weight of about 80–145 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around  20–25 Years and is currently classified as Vulnerable.. Found in: India, Nepal, and Sri Lanka. Likes: Forest areas with termite mounds, fruits, and water sources.. Dislikes: Habitat destruction and human disturbance.. Fun facts: Sloth bears use their long, flexible lips to suck up termites and ants like a vacuum cleaner. They can close their nostrils while eating insects so bugs don’t crawl inside — built-in bug shield! They are one of the few bears that actively chase predators away instead of running! Weight: 80–145 KG. Length: 60–90 CM.

Native to Asia and Africa, it thrives in Farmlands, open forests, gardens, and urban areas.

Dislikes: Isolation, stress, lack of stimulation. Fun facts: Color-morph parakeets are naturally occurring rare variations that can be bright yellow, white, or even blue! Weight: 110–140 G. This species lives for around 20–25 Years and is currently classified as not evaluated.
story_description.hi: यहां हमारे पास रोज़-रिंग्ड पैराकीट (कलर मॉर्फ) है, जो तोते, पैराकीट्स और मैकॉज़ समूह का एक उल्लेखनीय पक्षी है।. एशिया और अफ्रीका का मूल निवासी, यह खेतों, खुले जंगलों, बगीचों और शहरी क्षेत्रों में पनपता है. यह अपना समय फलों, बीजों, अनाजों और कलियों को खाकर व्यतीत करता है. और सामाजिक संपर्क, चढ़ाई, उड़ान, मुखर संचार का आनंद लेता है, लेकिन अलगाव, तनाव, उत्तेजना की कमी से बचता है. 38-42 सेमी के आकार और लगभग 110-140 ग्राम के वजन के साथ, यह अपने परिवेश के लिए अच्छी तरह से अनुकूलित है. यह प्रजाति लगभग 20-25 वर्षों तक जीवित रहती है और वर्तमान में इसे मूल्यांकन नहीं किए गए के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है.

narrative.en: The Rose-ringed Parakeet is a highly intelligent and social parrot known for the colored ring around the neck of adult males. “Color Morph” refers to specially bred variations with unusual feather colors such as blue, yellow, white, or lutino instead of the natural green color.
narrative.hi: रोज़-रिंग्ड पैराकीट एक बुद्धिमान और सामाजिक तोता है, जो नर पक्षी की गर्दन के आसपास बने रंगीन घेरे के लिए जाना जाता है। “कलर मॉर्फ” उन विशेष रंग रूपों को कहा जाता है जिनमें प्राकृतिक हरे रंग के बजाय नीला, पीला, सफेद या अन्य रंग दिखाई देते हैं।

Sambar Deer (Rusa unicolor) is classified under Mammal. Description: Sambar Deer is a animal belonging to the Deer /  Carved group. 
It is found across India, Bangladesh, China,  Nepal, Sri Lanka, and parts of Southeast Asia., typically in Forests, marshlands, and grasslands.. 
It feeds on Leaves, grasses, and fruits. and enjoys Dense forests, wetlands, and areas close to water., while avoiding Habitat destruction and excessive human disturbance.. 
This species measures around 1.2–1.6 Meter and weighs approximately 150–300 KG. 
It lives up to 20–26 Years, with a gestation period of About 8 months and clutch size of 1 Calf. 
Its conservation status is Vulnerable.. Found in: India, Bangladesh, China,  Nepal, Sri Lanka, and parts of Southeast Asia.. Likes: Dense forests, wetlands, and areas close to water.. Dislikes: Habitat destruction and excessive human disturbance.. Fun facts: Sambar deer, the largest deer species in India, are a vital prey for tigers and alert the forest with their deep, resonant alarm calls that carry over long distances. Weight: 150–300 KG. Length: 1.2–1.6 Meter.

distribution.en: India, Bangladesh, China,  Nepal, Sri Lanka, and parts of Southeast Asia.
distribution.hi: भारत, बांग्लादेश, चीन, नेपाल, श्रीलंका और दक्षिण-पूर्व एशिया के कुछ हिस्सों में।

notes.hi: सांभर हिरण भारत में पाई जाने वाली सबसे बड़ी हिरण प्रजाति है और बाघों का एक महत्वपूर्ण शिकार है।

breeding_pattern.hi: मौसमी चरम के साथ पूरे वर्ष प्रजनन होता रहता है।

story_description.en:
Sambar Deer is a animal belonging to the Deer /  Carved group. 
It is found across India, Bangladesh, China,  Nepal, Sri Lanka, and parts of Southeast Asia., typically in Forests, marshlands, and grasslands.. 
It feeds on Leaves, grasses, and fruits. and enjoys Dense forests, wetlands, and areas close to water., while avoiding Habitat destruction and excessive human disturbance.. 
This species measures around 1.2–1.6 Meter and weighs approximately 150–300 KG. 
It lives up to 20–26 Years, with a gestation period of About 8 months and clutch size of 1 Calf. 
Its conservation status is Vulnerable.
story_description.hi: सांबर हिरण हिरण/नक्काशीदार समूह से संबंधित एक जानवर है. यह भारत, बांग्लादेश, चीन, नेपाल, श्रीलंका और दक्षिण पूर्व एशिया के कुछ हिस्सों में पाया जाता है. , आमतौर पर जंगलों, दलदली भूमि और घास के मैदानों में. यह पत्तियां, घास और फल खाता है. और घने जंगलों, आर्द्रभूमियों और पानी के करीब के क्षेत्रों का आनंद लेता है. , पर्यावास विनाश और अत्यधिक मानवीय अशांति से बचते हुए. इस प्रजाति का आकार 1 के आसपास है. 2-1. 6 मीटर और वजन लगभग 150-300 किलोग्राम. यह 20-26 साल तक जीवित रहती है, गर्भधारण की अवधि लगभग 8 महीने और क्लच का आकार 1 बछड़े के बराबर होता है।. इसकी संरक्षण स्थिति असुरक्षित है.

narrative.en: The sambar deer is the largest deer species in India. Its strong body and keen senses help it survive in dense forests where it often becomes prey for big predators like tigers.
narrative.hi: सांभर भारत का सबसे बड़ा हिरण है। इसका मजबूत शरीर और तेज इंद्रियाँ इसे घने जंगलों में जीवित रहने में मदद करती हैं, जहाँ यह बाघ जैसे बड़े शिकारियों का शिकार बन सकता है।

Indian Wolf (Canis lupus pallipes) is classified under Mammal. Description: Here we have the Indian Wolf, a remarkable animal from the Canids /  Dog Family group. 
Native to India and Pakistan, it thrives in Semi-arid grasslands, and scrublands. 
It spends its time feeding on  Antelope fawns, rodents, and livestock and enjoys Open landscapes, areas with prey, and quiet territories., but tends to avoid Human disturbance, habitat loss, and lack of prey.. 
With a size of 60–80 CM and weight of about 18–27 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 10–12 Years and is currently classified as Endangered.. Found in: India and Pakistan. Likes: Open landscapes, areas with prey, and quiet territories.. Dislikes: Human disturbance, habitat loss, and lack of prey.. Fun facts: Indian wolves communicate using over a dozen different calls, including howls, whines, and yelps. They survive extreme Indian heat where most wolves couldn’t last! Indian wolves are one of the oldest wolf lineages dating back 400,000 years — older than many European wolves! (need fact check - corrected, it is true) Weight: 18–27 KG. Length: 60–80 CM.

story_description.en:
Here we have the Indian Wolf, a remarkable animal from the Canids /  Dog Family group. 
Native to India and Pakistan, it thrives in Semi-arid grasslands, and scrublands. 
It spends its time feeding on  Antelope fawns, rodents, and livestock and enjoys Open landscapes, areas with prey, and quiet territories., but tends to avoid Human disturbance, habitat loss, and lack of prey.. 
With a size of 60–80 CM and weight of about 18–27 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 10–12 Years and is currently classified as Endangered.
story_description.hi: यहां हमारे पास भारतीय भेड़िया है, जो कैनिड्स/कुत्ता परिवार समूह का एक उल्लेखनीय जानवर है. भारत और पाकिस्तान का मूल निवासी, यह अर्ध-शुष्क घास के मैदानों और झाड़ियों में पनपता है. यह अपना समय मृग के बच्चों, कृंतकों और पशुओं को खाने में बिताता है और खुले परिदृश्य, शिकार वाले क्षेत्रों और शांत प्रदेशों का आनंद लेता है।. , लेकिन मानवीय अशांति, आवास हानि और शिकार की कमी से बचने की प्रवृत्ति रखता है. 60-80 सीएम के आकार और लगभग 18-27 किलोग्राम वजन के साथ, यह अपने परिवेश के लिए अच्छी तरह से अनुकूलित है. यह प्रजाति लगभग 10-12 वर्षों तक जीवित रहती है और वर्तमान में इसे लुप्तप्राय के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है.

narrative.en: The Indian Wolf is a subspecies of the gray wolf adapted to the dry grasslands and semi-desert regions of the Indian subcontinent. It is smaller and slimmer than wolves found in colder regions and is known for its intelligence, teamwork, and excellent hunting skills.
narrative.hi: भारतीय भेड़िया ग्रे वुल्फ की एक उपप्रजाति है, जो भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप के शुष्क घास के मैदानों और अर्ध-रेगिस्तानी क्षेत्रों में पाई जाती है। यह ठंडे क्षेत्रों के भेड़ियों की तुलना में आकार में छोटा और पतला होता है तथा अपनी बुद्धिमत्ता, समूह सहयोग और शिकार कौशल के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

likes.en: Open landscapes, areas with prey, and quiet territories.
likes.hi: खुले परिदृश्य, शिकार वाले क्षेत्र और शांत क्षेत्र।

dislikes.en: Human disturbance, habitat loss, and lack of prey.
dislikes.hi: मानवीय अशांति, निवास स्थान की हानि, और शिकार की कमी।

threat_status.hi: संकटग्रस्त

story_audio.en: Notice how lean they are? They are built for long-distance running in the hot Indian plains.
story_audio.hi: देखिए ये कितने दुबले हैं? ये भारतीय मैदानों की गर्मी में लंबी दूरी तक दौड़ने के लिए बने हैं।

fun_facts.en: Indian wolves communicate using over a dozen different calls, including howls, whines, and yelps.
fun_facts.hi: भारतीय भेड़िये एक दर्जन से अधिक विभिन्न आवाजों के माध्यम से संवाद करते हैं, जिनमें हुआँ-हुआँ (howls), कराहना (whines) और छोटी चीखें (yelps) शामिल हैं।

fun_facts.en: They survive extreme Indian heat where most wolves couldn’t last!
fun_facts.hi: ये भारत की उस अत्यधिक गर्मी में भी जीवित रह सकते हैं जहाँ अधिकांश भेड़िये टिक नहीं पाते!

fun_facts.en: Indian wolves are one of the oldest wolf lineages dating back 400,000 years — older than many European wolves! (need fact check - corrected, it is true)
fun_facts.hi: भारतीय भेड़िए सबसे प्राचीन भेड़िया वंशों में से एक हैं, जिनका इतिहास लगभग 4,00,000 वर्ष पुराना है — कई यूरोपीय भेड़ियों से भी अधिक प्राचीन!

Indian Spotted Pond Turtle (Geoclemys hamiltonii) is classified under Reptiles. Description: Indian Spotted Pond Turtle is a reptile belonging to the Turtles and Tortoises group. 
It is found across India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Nepal, typically in Freshwater ponds, lakes, marshes, and slow rivers. 
It feeds on Aquatic plants, insects, fish, and small animals and enjoys Warm water, basking in sunlight, aquatic vegetation, while avoiding Pollution, habitat loss, and disturbance. 
This species measures around 30–40 CM and weighs approximately 2–5 KG. 
It lives up to 20–40 Years, with a gestation period of 60–80 days and clutch size of 10–30 Eggs. 
Its conservation status is not evaluated.. Found in: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Nepal. Likes: Warm water, basking in sunlight, aquatic vegetation. Dislikes: Pollution, habitat loss, and disturbance. Fun facts: Its shell has unique yellow spots that help in camouflage. It spends most of its life in water but comes out to bask. Weight: 2–5 KG. Length: 30–40 CM.

Indian Rock Python (Python molurus) is classified under Reptiles. Description: The Indian rock python is a large, non-venomous snake known for its powerful body and ability to constrict prey. It is commonly found in forests, grasslands, and near water bodies across India. 
It belongs to the Lizards and snakes group and is found in  India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Pakistan and Bangladesh., mainly in Grasslands, forests, and swamps.. 
Its diet consists of Mammals, birds, and reptiles., and it prefers Warm climates, dense vegetation, and water sources while avoiding Cold weather and habitat disturbance. 
It measures about 3–4.5 Meters and weighs around 40–60 KG. 
With a lifespan of 20–30 Years, gestation period of 60–90 days, and clutch size of 20–50 Eggs, 
its conservation status is not evaluated.. Found in: India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Pakistan and Bangladesh.. Likes: Warm climates, dense vegetation, and water sources. Dislikes: Cold weather and habitat disturbance. Fun facts: While constricting the prey, pythons can stop blood flow to the brain in seconds — prey passes out before it even realizes what’s happening! Flexible skull bones allow pythons to swallow prey much wider than their head. Weight: 40–60 KG. Length: 3–4.5 Meters.

distribution.hi: भारत, नेपाल, श्रीलंका, भूटान, पाकिस्तान और बांग्लादेश।

story_description.hi:
इंडियन रॉक पाइथन एक बड़ा, गैर-विषैला सांप है, जो अपने शक्तिशाली शरीर और शिकार को जकड़कर मारने की क्षमता के लिए जाना जाता है। यह भारत में जंगलों, घास के मैदानों और जल स्रोतों के पास आमतौर पर पाया जाता है।

यह छिपकली और सांप समूह से संबंधित है और भारत, नेपाल, श्रीलंका, भूटान, पाकिस्तान और बांग्लादेश में पाया जाता है, मुख्य रूप से घास के मैदानों, जंगलों और दलदली क्षेत्रों में।

इसका आहार स्तनधारी, पक्षी और सरीसृप होते हैं, और यह गर्म जलवायु, घनी वनस्पति और जल स्रोतों वाले स्थान पसंद करता है, जबकि ठंडे मौसम और आवास में व्यवधान से बचता है।

इसकी लंबाई लगभग 3–4.5 मीटर और वजन लगभग 40–60 किलोग्राम होता है।

इसका जीवनकाल 20–30 वर्ष होता है, गर्भावधि अवधि 60–90 दिन होती है और यह एक बार में 20–50 अंडे देता है। इसका संरक्षण स्तर अभी मूल्यांकित नहीं है।

Indian Peafowl (Pavo cristatus) is classified under Birds. Description: The Indian Peafowl is one of the most beautiful birds in the world. During the rainy season, the male spreads his magnificent feathers like a fan and performs a graceful dance to attract the female. This spectacular display has made the peacock a symbol of beauty and pride in many cultures. 
It belongs to the Francolins and Pheasants group and is found in India, Sri Lanka, Nepal; and introduced worldwide, mainly in Forest edges, farmlands, scrublands, and open woodland areas.. 
Its diet consists of  Seeds, grains, insects, and small snakes., and it prefers Open areas for displaying feathers, trees for roosting, and water sources nearby. while avoiding Predators and constant disturbance from humans.. 
It measures about Up to 2.2 Meters and weighs around 4–6 KG. 
With a lifespan of 20–25 Years, gestation period of 27–30 days, and clutch size of 3–6 eggs, 
its conservation status is Least Concern.. Found in: India, Sri Lanka, Nepal; and introduced worldwide. Likes: Open areas for displaying feathers, trees for roosting, and water sources nearby.. Dislikes: Predators and constant disturbance from humans.. Fun facts: Their feathers don’t have colour - they reflect light like a rainbow! Their eyes are usually blue or dark, not red like albinos In sunlight, their white feathers glow like silk Weight: 4–6 KG. Length: Up to 2.2 Meters.

.

narrative.en: The Indian Peafowl is one of the most beautiful birds in the world. During the rainy season, the male spreads his magnificent feathers like a fan and performs a graceful dance to attract the female. This spectacular display has made the peacock a symbol of beauty and pride in many cultures.
narrative.hi: भारतीय मोर दुनिया के सबसे सुंदर पक्षियों में से एक है। बारिश के मौसम में नर अपने शानदार पंखों को पंखे की तरह फैलाकर मादा को आकर्षित करने के लिए सुंदर नृत्य करता है। यह अद्भुत दृश्य मोर को सुंदरता और गर्व का प्रतीक बनाता है।

likes.en: Open areas for displaying feathers, trees for roosting, and water sources nearby.
likes.hi: पंखों को प्रदर्शित करने के लिए खुले क्षेत्र, बसेरा के लिए पेड़ और आस-पास जल स्रोत।

dislikes.en: Predators and constant disturbance from humans.
dislikes.hi: शिकारी और मनुष्यों की ओर से निरंतर अशांति।

threat_status.hi: कम से कम चिंता का विषय

story_audio.en: Look at those vibrant feathers! Only males have this stunning train, which they use in a shimmering dance to impress the females.
story_audio.hi: इन खूबसूरत पंखों को देखिए! केवल नर मोर के पास ही ऐसी लंबी पूंछ होती है, जिसे वे मादा को रिझाने के लिए नृत्य के दौरान फैलाते हैं।

fun_facts.en: Their feathers don’t have colour - they reflect light like a rainbow!
fun_facts.hi: इनके पंखों में वास्तव में कोई रंग नहीं होता - वे इंद्रधनुष की तरह केवल प्रकाश को प्रतिबिंब (reflect) करते हैं!

fun_facts.en: Their eyes are usually blue or dark, not red like albinos
fun_facts.hi: इनकी आँखें आमतौर पर नीली या गहरी होती हैं, अल्बिनो (albinos) की तरह लाल नहीं।

fun_facts.en: In sunlight, their white feathers glow like silk
fun_facts.hi: सूरज की रोशनी में, इनके सफेद पंख रेशम (silk) की तरह चमकते हैं।

Indian Jackal (Canis aureus indicus) is classified under Birds. Description: Here we have the Indian Jackal, a remarkable bird from the Canids /  Dog Family group. 
Native to India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka, it thrives in Forest edges, grasslands, and villages. 
It spends its time feeding on Small mammals, birds, fruits, insects, and carrion and enjoys Areas with food sources, water, and cover for hiding., but tends to avoid Heavy human disturbance and loss of habitat.. 
With a size of 40–50 CM and weight of about 6–11 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 8–12 Years and is currently classified as Least Concern.. Found in: India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka. Likes: Areas with food sources, water, and cover for hiding.. Dislikes: Heavy human disturbance and loss of habitat.. Fun facts: Jackals frequently scavenge leftovers from large predators such as tigers and leopards, apart from actively hunting small prey. It can survive in jungles, deserts, farms, and even near cities, ultimate adapter! Jackals usually move in pairs or family groups of parents and offsprings, teamwork wins! Weight: 6–11 KG. Length: 40–50 CM.

narrative.en: The Indian Jackal is a clever and adaptable wild canid found across the Indian subcontinent. It has a golden-brown coat, pointed ears, and a bushy tail. Indian Jackals are known for their loud howls, scavenging habits, and ability to survive in forests, grasslands, and even near villages.

Hog Deer (Axis porcinus) is classified under Mammal. Description: Hog Deer is a animal belonging to the Deer /  Carved group. 
It is found across Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cambodia, India, Nepal, Thailand, and Pakistan., typically in Tall grasslands and riverine forests.. 
It feeds on Grasses, fallen fruits, and tender shoots. and enjoys Dense tall grasses and wetlands for hiding from predators., while avoiding Habitat loss, hunting, and disturbance by humans.. 
This species measures around  60–70 CM and weighs approximately 30–50 KG. 
It lives up to 15–20 Years, with a gestation period of 220–230 days and clutch size of 1 fawn. 
Its conservation status is Endangered.. Found in: Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cambodia, India, Nepal, Thailand, and Pakistan. Likes: Dense tall grasses and wetlands for hiding from predators.. Dislikes: Habitat loss, hunting, and disturbance by humans.. Fun facts: Hog deer run with their heads low like hogs, allowing them to dash under thick bushes to escape predators. Its body shape is specially built for flooded grasslands and swamps. A wetland athlete! It runs with its head low like a wild boar that’s why it’s called “hog” deer! Weight: 30–50 KG. Length: 60–70 CM.

story_description.hi: हॉग हिरण हिरण/नक्काशीदार समूह से संबंधित एक जानवर है. यह बांग्लादेश, भूटान, कंबोडिया, भारत, नेपाल, थाईलैंड और पाकिस्तान में पाया जाता है. , आमतौर पर ऊंचे घास के मैदानों और नदी के जंगलों में. यह घास, गिरे हुए फल और कोमल टहनियों को खाता है. और शिकारियों से छिपने के लिए घनी लंबी घास और आर्द्रभूमि का आनंद लेता है. , जबकि निवास स्थान के नुकसान, शिकार और मनुष्यों द्वारा अशांति से बचना. इस प्रजाति का माप लगभग 60-70 सेमी और वजन लगभग 30-50 किलोग्राम होता है. यह 15-20 साल तक जीवित रहता है, गर्भधारण की अवधि 220-230 दिन और क्लच का आकार 1 हिरण के बच्चे के बराबर होता है।. इसकी संरक्षण स्थिति लुप्तप्राय है.

narrative.en: The Hog Deer is a medium-sized deer named for its pig-like running style, where it lowers its head while moving through dense grass. It has a sturdy body, short legs, and a brown coat that may develop white spots in young animals. Hog Deer are shy and usually remain hidden in tall grasslands.
narrative.hi: पाड़ा हिरण एक मध्यम आकार का हिरण है, जिसका नाम इसके सूअर जैसे दौड़ने के तरीके के कारण पड़ा है। दौड़ते समय यह अपना सिर नीचे रखता है और घनी घास के बीच से गुजरता है। इसका शरीर मजबूत, पैर छोटे और रंग भूरा होता है। छोटे बच्चों में सफेद धब्बे दिखाई दे सकते हैं। यह हिरण शर्मीला होता है और अधिकतर ऊंची घास में छिपा रहता है।

likes.en: Dense tall grasses and wetlands for hiding from predators.
likes.hi: शिकारियों से छिपने के लिए घनी लंबी घास और आर्द्रभूमि।

dislikes.en: Habitat loss, hunting, and disturbance by humans.
dislikes.hi: मनुष्यों द्वारा पर्यावास की हानि, शिकार और अशांति।

threat_status.hi: संकटग्रस्त

story_audio.en: They run with their head low, looking a bit like a hog or pig. That's where the name comes from!
story_audio.hi: ये सिर झुकाकर दौड़ते हैं, जिससे ये थोड़े सूअर जैसे दिखते हैं। इसीलिए इन्हें 'पाढ़ा' कहा जाता है।

fun_facts.en: Hog deer run with their heads low like hogs, allowing them to dash under thick bushes to escape predators.
fun_facts.hi: हॉग हिरण सूअरों की तरह अपना सिर नीचे करके दौड़ते हैं, जिससे वे शिकारियों से बचने के लिए घनी झाड़ियों के नीचे छिप जाते हैं।

fun_facts.en: Its body shape is specially built for flooded grasslands and swamps. A wetland athlete!
fun_facts.hi: इसका शरीर विशेष रूप से बाढ़ वाले घास के मैदानों और दलदलों के लिए बना है बिल्कुल एक 'वेटलैंड एथलीट' की तरह!

fun_facts.en: It runs with its head low like a wild boar that’s why it’s called “hog” deer!
fun_facts.hi: यह जंगली सूअर की तरह अपना सिर नीचे करके दौड़ता है इसीलिए इसे 'हॉग' (Hog) डियर कहा जाता है!

Hippopotamus Hippo (Hippopotamus amphibius) is classified under Mammals. Description: Hippopotamus is a mammal belonging to the Hippo group. 
It is found across Sub-Saharan Africa., typically in Rivers, lakes, and freshwater wetlands.. 
It feeds on Grasses (primarily), occasionally aquatic vegetation. and enjoys Water immersion, mud wallowing, grazing at night, staying in groups, while avoiding Drought, habitat shrinkage, human disturbance. 
This species measures around 1.3–1.6 Meter tall and weighs approximately 1,400–3,200 KG. 
It lives up to 40–50 Years, with a gestation period of 8 months and clutch size of 1 Calf. 
Its conservation status is Vulnerable .. Found in: Sub-Saharan Africa.. Likes: Water immersion, mud wallowing, grazing at night, staying in groups. Dislikes: Drought, habitat shrinkage, human disturbance. Fun facts: Hippos spend most of their day in water to keep cool—yet they can run faster than humans on land! They can run faster than a human on land despite weighing over a ton! Their huge mouths can open almost 180 degrees wide - real-life monster jaws! Weight: 1,400–3,200 KG. Length: 1.3–1.6 Meter tall.

distribution.en: Sub-Saharan Africa.
distribution.hi: सहारा के दक्षिणी अफ्रीका के देश।

habitat.en: Rivers, lakes, and freshwater wetlands.
habitat.hi: नदियाँ, झीलें और मीठे पानी के दलदली इलाके।

diet.hi: मुख्य रूप से घास और कभी-कभी जलीय पौधे।

activity.en: Nocturnal (feeding at night), spends daytime submerged in water, semi-social.
activity.hi: रात्रिचर (रात में भोजन करना), दिन का समय पानी में डूबा हुआ, अर्ध-सामाजिक।

notes.en: Hippos are highly territorial and considered one of the most dangerous animals in Africa.

breeding_pattern.en: Every 2 years
breeding_pattern.hi: हर 2 साल में

narrative.en: The hippopotamus, often seen calmly resting in water, is actually a powerful and territorial animal.As the sun sets, it leaves the water to graze on grass, traveling several kilometers at night.Despite its bulky body, it can run surprisingly fast on land and fiercely protects its territory.
narrative.hi: दरियाई घोड़ा, जिसे अक्सर पानी में शांति से आराम करते हुए देखा जाता है, वास्तव में एक शक्तिशाली और क्षेत्रीय जानवर है। जैसे ही सूरज डूबता है, यह घास चरने के लिए पानी छोड़ देता है, रात में कई किलोमीटर की यात्रा करता है। अपने भारी शरीर के बावजूद, यह जमीन पर आश्चर्यजनक रूप से तेजी से दौड़ सकता है और अपने क्षेत्र की जमकर रक्षा करता है।

His long silver mane shone in the golden light as he led his family across the dry hills. The troop moved together, searching for fruits, seeds, and water. its conservation status is Least Concern.. Found in: Horn of Africa and southwestern Arabia.. Likes: Rocky hills, open areas, and places with water and food.. Dislikes: Extreme heat without water and human disturbance.. Fun facts: Hamadryas baboons live in large, organized troops led by a dominant male—almost like royal families!
