narrative.en: The Hamadryas Baboon is a large and highly social primate found in parts of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. Adult males are famous for their long silver-white mane, while females are smaller and brown in color. These baboons live in complex social groups and spend much of their time on rocky cliffs and open dry landscapes.
narrative.hi: हमाड्रायस बैबून एक बड़ा और अत्यंत सामाजिक प्राइमेट है, जो अफ्रीका और अरब प्रायद्वीप के कुछ भागों में पाया जाता है। वयस्क नर अपनी लंबी चांदी-सफेद अयाल के लिए प्रसिद्ध होते हैं, जबकि मादाएं आकार में छोटी और भूरे रंग की होती हैं। ये बैबून जटिल सामाजिक समूहों में रहते हैं और अक्सर चट्टानी तथा शुष्क क्षेत्रों में पाए जाते हैं।

story_description.hi: यहां हमारे पास चार सींग वाला मृग (चौसिंघा) है, जो हिरण/नक्काशीदार समूह का एक उल्लेखनीय जानवर है. भारत और नेपाल के मूल निवासी. , यह शुष्क पर्णपाती जंगलों और झाड़ियों में पनपता है. यह अपना समय पत्तियां, घास और फल खाकर व्यतीत करता है. और शांत वन किनारों, घास के मैदानों और जल स्रोतों का आनंद लेता है. , लेकिन मानवीय अशांति और शिकारियों से बचने की प्रवृत्ति रखता है. 55-65 सेमी के आकार और लगभग 17-22 किलोग्राम वजन के साथ, यह अपने परिवेश के लिए अच्छी तरह से अनुकूलित है. यह प्रजाति लगभग 10-12 वर्षों तक जीवित रहती है और वर्तमान में इसे अतिसंवेदनशील के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है.

narrative.en:
The Four-horned Antelope (Chousingha) is a rare antelope species recognized for having four distinct horns.
It is mainly found in dry forests and grasslands of India and Nepal, where it feeds on grasses, leaves, and fruits.
narrative.hi:
चौसिंगा (चार सींग वाला मृग), एक दुर्लभ मृग प्रजाति है जो अपने चार सींगों के कारण विशेष रूप से पहचानी जाती है।
यह मुख्यतः भारत और नेपाल के सूखे जंगलों तथा घास के मैदानों में पाया जाता है और घास, पत्तियाँ तथा फल खाता है।

dislikes.hi: मानवीय अशांति और शिकारी.

threat_status.hi: असुरक्षित

fun_facts.en: It is the only antelope with four horns - two in front, two behind!
fun_facts.hi: यह पृथ्वी पर इकलौता ऐसा मृग  है जिसके चार सींग होते हैं - दो आगे और दो पीछे!

fun_facts.en: Scientists still don’t fully know why it evolved four horns.

It is found across Asia, Europe, and Africa., typically in Semi-arid plains, open countryside, cliffs, and near human settlements.. 
It feeds on Carrion, eggs, insects, and organic waste. and enjoys Open areas, carcasses, eggs, rocky nesting sites, while avoiding Habitat loss, poisoning, disturbance near nesting sites. 
This species measures around  60–70 CM and weighs approximately 1.5–2.3 KG. 
It lives up to 30–40 Years, with a gestation period of 39–45 days and clutch size of 1–3 Eggs.

Eclectus Parrot (Eclectus roratus) is classified under Bird. Description: Here we have the Eclectus Parrot, a remarkable animal from the Parrots, Parakeets and Macaws group. 
Native to New Guinea, Indonesia, Solomon Islands, and northern Australia, it thrives in Rainforests, and plantations.. 
It spends its time feeding on Fruits, figs, seeds, and blossoms. and enjoys Fresh fruits, tree hollows, social interaction, climbing, but tends to avoid Isolation, loud disturbance, habitat loss. 
With a size of 35–45 CM and weight of about 350–500 Gram, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 30–50 Years and is currently classified as Least Concern .. Found in: New Guinea, northeastern Australia, Solomon Islands, and Indonesia.. Likes: Fresh fruits, tree hollows, social interaction, climbing. Dislikes: Isolation, loud disturbance, habitat loss. Fun facts: Male and female eclectus parrots look so different that they were once believed to be separate species! Instead of typical feathers, their plumage looks like fine fur, and they have an unusually long digestive tract designed specifically to absorb nutrients from tropical fruits. Weight: 350–500 Gram. Common Rhea (Rhea americana) is classified under Birds. Description: Here we have the Common Rhea, a remarkable animal from the Flightless birds group. 
Native to Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay., it thrives in Grasslands, pampas, and savannas.. 
It spends its time feeding on Leaves, seeds, fruits, and insects. and enjoys Open plains with tall grasses and easy access to food., but tends to avoid Dense forests and heavily populated human areas.. 
With a size of 1.5 Meter and weight of about 20–27 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 10–15 Years and is currently classified as Near Threatened.. Found in: Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay.. Likes: Open plains with tall grasses and easy access to food.. Dislikes: Dense forests and heavily populated human areas.. Fun facts: Rhea cannot fly, but with strong legs, they run fast and use their wings like balancing sails! They swallow stones to grind food because they don’t have teeth — built-in rock grinder stomach! Weight: 20–27 KG. Length: 1.5 Meter.

Common Rat Snake (Ptyas mucosa) is classified under Reptiles. Description: The common rat snake is a non-venomous and fast-moving snake widely found in India. It is known for controlling rodent populations and is often seen near farms and human settlements. 
It belongs to the Lizards and snakes group and is found in Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia, mainly in Farmlands, forests, and urban areas.. 
Its diet consists of Rodents, birds, eggs, and lizards., and it prefers Warm environments, abundant prey, and water sources while avoiding Cold weather and human disturbance. 
It measures about 1.5–2.5 Meter and weighs around 1–3 KG. 
With a lifespan of 10–15 Years, gestation period of 60–80 days, and clutch size of 6–18 Eggs, 
its conservation status is not evaluated.. Found in: Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. Likes: Warm environments, abundant prey, and water sources. Dislikes: Cold weather and human disturbance. Fun facts: Indian rat snakes are non-venomous and help farmers by controlling rodent populations. It controls rat populations so well that farmers consider it a natural pest killer! Some grow longer than 3 metres — longer than a small car! Weight: 1–3 KG. Length: 1.5–2.5 Meter.

story_description.hi:
कॉमन रैट स्नेक एक विषहीन और तेज़ गति से चलने वाला साँप है, जो पूरे भारत में व्यापक रूप से पाया जाता है। यह चूहों की संख्या नियंत्रित करने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है और अक्सर खेतों, कृषि क्षेत्रों और मानव बस्तियों के आसपास देखा जाता है।

यह छिपकली और साँप (Lizards and Snakes) समूह से संबंधित है और भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप तथा दक्षिण-पूर्व एशिया में पाया जाता है, विशेष रूप से खेतों, जंगलों और शहरी क्षेत्रों में।

इसका आहार कृंतक (चूहे), पक्षी, अंडे और छिपकलियाँ हैं। यह गर्म वातावरण, पर्याप्त शिकार और जल स्रोतों को पसंद करता है, जबकि ठंडे मौसम और मानव हस्तक्षेप से बचता है।

इसकी लंबाई लगभग 1.5–2.5 मीटर होती है और वजन लगभग 1–3 किलोग्राम होता है।

इसका जीवनकाल 10–15 वर्ष होता है, गर्भावधि अवधि 60–80 दिन होती है, और एक बार में 6–18 अंडे देता है।

इसकी संरक्षण स्थिति (Conservation Status) अभी मूल्यांकित नहीं की गई है।

Common Ostrich (Struthio camelus) is classified under Bird. Description: In the wide savannas of Africa, a giant ostrich ran swiftly across the land. Though it could not fly, its long powerful legs helped it reach speeds of up to 70 km per hour. The ostrich watched the horizon carefully to spot danger from far away. Near a sandy nest on the ground, the parents protected their large eggs. Soon the chicks hatched and followed their parents across the golden grasslands. 
It belongs to the Flightless birds group and is found in Africa and introduced in Australia., mainly in  Savannas, deserts, and grasslands.. 
Its diet consists of Seeds, shrubs, roots, and insects., and it prefers Open grasslands and areas with good visibility. while avoiding Dense forests and wet swampy areas.. 
It measures about 2–2.7 Meter and weighs around 90–130 KG. 
With a lifespan of  40–50 Years, gestation period of About 40–45 days, and clutch size of 10–15 Eggs, 
its conservation status is Least Concern.. Found in: Africa and introduced in Australia.. Likes: Open grasslands and areas with good visibility.. Dislikes: Dense forests and wet swampy areas.. Fun facts: The ostrich is the world’s largest bird, and its eyes are bigger than its brain - perfect for spotting predators! They can sprint up to 70 km/h — fastest bird on Earth, no wings needed. They can sprint up to 70 km/h — fastest bird on Earth, no wings needed! Weight: 90–130 KG. Length: 2–2.7 Meter.

Chinkara Antelope (Gazella bennettii) is classified under Mammal. Description: Chinkara  is a animal belonging to the Antelope and Bovid group. 
It is found across India, Pakistan, and Iran., typically in  Arid plains, deserts, and dry scrublands.. 
It feeds on Grasses, leaves, wild fruits, and desert shrubs. and enjoys Open grasslands, desert shrubs, and quiet areas., while avoiding Human disturbance and predators.. 
This species measures around 60–74 CM and weighs approximately 20–25 KG. 
It lives up to 12–15 Years, with a gestation period of  5–6 months and clutch size of 1–2 fawns. 
Its conservation status is Least Concern.. Found in: India, Pakistan, and Iran. Likes: Open grasslands, desert shrubs, and quiet areas.. Dislikes: Human disturbance and predators.. Fun facts: Chinkaras can survive harsh deserts by getting most of their water from plants — rarely needing to drink. Chinkaras can live their entire life without drinking water. They get moisture only from plants! They can sprint at insane speeds and suddenly change direction. A predator confusion mode! Weight: 20–25 KG. Length: 60–74 CM.

narrative.en: The Chinkara, also known as the Indian Gazelle, is a graceful antelope that thrives in dry and harsh environments. It moves swiftly across open plains and deserts, using its sharp senses to detect danger. Its ability to survive with little water makes it perfectly adapted to desert life.

narrative.en: The Sangai, also known as the brow-antlered deer, is a rare and endangered species found only in Manipur, India. It is famous for its unique long, curved antlers and its ability to walk gracefully on floating grasslands called phumdis. It is also known as the “Dancing Deer” due to its delicate walking style.
narrative.hi:
संगाई, जिसे भौंह-मृग हिरण के रूप में भी जाना जाता है, एक अत्यंत दुर्लभ और संकटग्रस्त प्रजाति है जो केवल मणिपुर, भारत में पाई जाती है।
यह अपने लंबे, मुड़े हुए सींगों और “फुमदी” कहलाने वाली तैरती घासभूमियों पर सुंदरता से चलने के लिए जाना जाता है, इसी कारण इसे “डांसिंग डियर” भी कहा जाता है।

narrative.en: The Bonnet Macaque is a social monkey native to southern India. It gets its name from the bonnet-like arrangement of hair on its head. These monkeys are intelligent, adaptable, and often seen living near temples, villages, and forests.
narrative.hi: टोपीदार वानर दक्षिण भारत में पाया जाने वाला एक सामाजिक बंदर है। इसके सिर पर बालों की टोपी जैसी बनावट के कारण इसका नाम “बोनट” पड़ा। यह बंदर बुद्धिमान और अनुकूलनशील होता है तथा अक्सर मंदिरों, गांवों और जंगलों के आसपास देखा जाता है।

likes.en: Trees, areas with food sources, and safe places to rest.
likes.hi: पेड़, भोजन के स्रोतों वाले क्षेत्र और आराम करने के लिए सुरक्षित स्थान।

dislikes.en: Lack of food and disturbances in their habitat.
dislikes.hi: भोजन की कमी और उनके आवास में गड़बड़ी।

threat_status.hi: कम से कम चिंता का विषय

story_audio.en: Look at the hair on its head—it looks like a little cap! They are very social and love to groom each other.
story_audio.hi: इसके सिर के बाल देखिए—ऐसा लगता है जैसे इसने टोपी पहनी हो! ये बहुत मिलनसार होते हैं।

fun_facts.en: Unlike the Rhesus Macaque, the Bonnet Macaque has a much longer tail and derives its name from the black tuft of hair on its head.
fun_facts.hi: रीसस मकाक के विपरीत, बोनट मकाक की पूंछ बहुत लंबी होती है और इसका नाम इसके सिर पर बालों के काले गुच्छे के कारण पड़ा है।

fun_facts.en: Bonnet macaques can learn traffic patterns to safely cross busy roads- a true street smart!
fun_facts.hi: बोनेट मकाक व्यस्त सड़कों को सुरक्षित रूप से पार करने के लिए ट्रैफिक पैटर्न समझ सकते हैं — यह है इन बंदरों का 'शातिर दिमाग'!

fun_facts.en: They recognize individual humans who feed or chase them — face memory unlocked! (fact check needed)
fun_facts.hi: वे अलग-अलग इंसानों को पहचानते हैं जो उन्हें खाना खिलाते हैं या उनका पीछा करते हैं - चेहरे की स्मृति अनलॉक!

Blackbuck Antelope (Antilope cervicapra) is classified under Mammals. Description: Here we have the Blackbuck 3, a remarkable mammal from the Antelope and Bovid group. 
Native to India, Nepal and reintroduced in Pakistan, it thrives in Grasslands, open plains, scrublands.. 
It spends its time feeding on Grasses, leaves, pods. and enjoys Open grasslands, dry areas, and herd living, but tends to avoid Dense forests, predators, and human disturbance. 
With a size of 74–84 CM and weight of about 25–45 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 12–16 Years and is currently classified as not evaluated.. Found in: India, Nepal; and reintroduced in Pakistan. Likes: Open grasslands, dry areas, and herd living. Dislikes: Dense forests, predators, and human disturbance. Fun facts: Blackbucks can run up to 80 km/h. Male blackbucks have elegant spiral horns carved by nature! Weight: 25–45 KG. Length: 74–84 CM.

Black Swan (Cygnus atratus) is classified under Birds. Description: Here we have the Black Swan, a remarkable animal from the Goose, Ducks and Swan group. Native to Australia, and Tasmania., it thrives in Lakes, wetlands, and rivers.. It spends its time feeding on Aquatic plants, algae, and grasses. and enjoys Calm water bodies, abundant aquatic plants, and open wetlands., but tends to avoid Polluted water, habitat disturbance, and excessive human activity.. 
With a size of 110 to 140 CM and weight of about 3.5–9 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 20–30 Years and is currently classified as Least Concern.. Found in: Australia, and Tasmania.. Likes: Calm water bodies, abundant aquatic plants, and open wetlands.. Dislikes: Polluted water, habitat disturbance, and excessive human activity.. Fun facts: Black swans form lifelong pair bonds — a graceful symbol of love and loyalty in the bird world! While most birds have 13-15 neck vertebrae, black swans have 23-25, causing the long s-shaped flexible neck that they use for feeding! Weight: 3.5–9 KG. Length: 110–140 CM.

narrative.en:
The Barasingha, also known as the Swamp Deer, is a large deer species famous for its majestic antlers with many branches.
It is mainly found in grasslands and swampy areas of India and Nepal, where it feeds on grasses and aquatic plants.

Indian Leopard (Panthera pardus fusca) is classified under Mammal. Description: Here we have the Indian Leopard, a remarkable animal from the Cats /  Felids group. 
Native to Bangladesh, Bhutan, China, Myanmar, and Pakistan., it thrives in Forests, mountains, grasslands, and even urban fringes.. 
It spends its time feeding on  Deer, monkeys, birds, and rodents. and enjoys Dense vegetation, rocky areas, and places with good hiding spots., but tends to avoid Human disturbance and habitat destruction.. 
With a size of 45–80 CM and weight of about 30–75 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 12–17 Years and is currently classified as Vulnerable.. Found in: India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, China, Myanmar, and Pakistan.. Likes: Dense vegetation, rocky areas, and places with good hiding spots.. Dislikes: Human disturbance and habitat destruction.. Fun facts: Leopards are incredibly strong and agile — they can carry prey heavier than themselves and hoist it high into trees to protect it from other predators. They can leap over 6 metres in one jump — Olympic-level athlete energy! [object Object] Weight: 30–75 KG. Length: 45–80 CM.

White Tiger (Panthera tigris tigris) is classified under Mammal. Description: The White Tiger is one of the most striking and rare color forms of the Bengal tiger. Its snowy white coat with dark stripes makes it one of the most admired animals in zoos around the world. 
It belongs to the Cats /  Felids group and is found in  India, China, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Bhutan., mainly in Forests, mangroves, and grasslands.. 
Its diet consists of Deer, wild pigs, nilgai, gaur, macaques, hares, reptiles, and peafowl., and it prefers Dense forests, water sources, and areas with abundant prey. while avoiding Human disturbance and habitat destruction.. 
It measures about Up to 110 CM and weighs around 100–260 KG. 
With a lifespan of  15–20 Years, gestation period of 95–110 days, and clutch size of 2–4 Cubs, 
its conservation status is Endangered .. Found in: India, China, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Bhutan.. Likes: Dense forests, water sources, and areas with abundant prey.. Dislikes: Human disturbance and habitat destruction.. Fun facts: White tigers are not albino — they have a recessive gene that reduces pigmentation but retains stripes, turning their orange fur snowy white with blue eyes. Indian Crested Porcupine (Hystrix indica) is classified under Mammal. Description: The Indian crested porcupine is a unique rodent known for its long, sharp quills. When threatened, it raises and rattles its quills to scare predators away. 
It belongs to the Otter /  Mustelid group and is found in  India, Pakistan, and the Arabian Peninsula., mainly in Grasslands, forests, and rocky hill regions.. 
Its diet consists of Roots, tubers, fruits, and bark., and it prefers Rocky shelters, burrows, and areas with abundant vegetation. while avoiding Disturbance near burrows and habitat destruction.. 
It measures about 60–90 CM and weighs around 11–18 KG. 
With a lifespan of 10–15 Years, gestation period of 90–112 days, and clutch size of 1–4 Young, 
its conservation status is Least Concern.. Found in: India, Pakistan, and the Arabian Peninsula.. Likes: Rocky shelters, burrows, and areas with abundant vegetation.. Dislikes: Disturbance near burrows and habitat destruction.. Fun facts: Indian crested porcupines use their hollow quills to produce a rattling sound as a warning signal. If threatened, they can charge backward, using their sharp quills as a formidable defence mechanism. They possess 20–50 cm long, flexible quills on their back for defense, and shorter, thicker quills for stabbing predators. They cannot shoot their quills, but the quills detach upon contact. [object Object] Weight: 11–18 KG. Length: 60–90 CM.

story_description.hi:
भारतीय क्रेस्टेड साही (Indian Crested Porcupine) एक अनोखा कृंतक है, जो अपने लंबे और नुकीले कांटों के लिए जाना जाता है।
खतरे के समय यह अपने कांटों को खड़ा कर और खड़खड़ाकर शिकारियों को डराकर दूर भगाता है।

यह भारत, पाकिस्तान और अरब प्रायद्वीप में पाया जाता है तथा मुख्य रूप से घासभूमि, जंगलों और चट्टानी पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में रहता है।
यह भूमिगत बिलों, चट्टानी आश्रयों और घनी वनस्पति वाले स्थानों को पसंद करता है, जबकि अपने बिलों के आसपास मानव हस्तक्षेप और आवास विनाश से बचता है।

इसका भोजन जड़ें, कंद, फल और पेड़ों की छाल होता है।
इसकी लंबाई लगभग 60–90 सेमी और वजन लगभग 11–18 किलोग्राम तक होता है।

इसका जीवनकाल लगभग 10–15 वर्ष होता है, गर्भावधि लगभग 90–112 दिनों की होती है, और यह सामान्यतः 1–4 शावकों को जन्म देता है।

प्रकृति संरक्षण की दृष्टि से इसकी स्थिति “Least Concern” मानी जाती है।

narrative.en:
The Indian Crested Porcupine is a large nocturnal rodent known for its sharp quills used for defense against predators.
It is found in forests, scrublands, and rocky areas across India, where it feeds on roots, fruits, bark, and crops.

यह भारत के जंगलों, झाड़ियों और चट्टानी क्षेत्रों में पाया जाता है तथा जड़ें, फल, छाल और फसलें खाता है।

narrative.hi: जंगल कैट एक मध्यम आकार की जंगली बिल्ली है जो एशिया और मध्य पूर्व के कुछ हिस्सों में पाई जाती है। इसका रंग रेतीला-भूरा होता है, पैर लंबे होते हैं और कान नुकीले होते हैं जिन पर छोटे बालों के गुच्छे होते हैं। यह एक कुशल शिकारी है और अक्सर आर्द्रभूमि और घास के मैदानों के पास देखा जाता है।

story_audio.en: Looks like a pet cat, but with longer legs! It can jump incredibly high to snatch a bird right out of the air.

fun_facts.en: Jungle cats can leap straight into the air to catch birds mid-flight like furry missiles!

Indian Elephant (Elephas maximus) is classified under Mammals. Description: The Indian elephant is a symbol of strength and wisdom. Living in close family groups, they travel long distances in search of food and water and play a vital role in maintaining forest ecosystems. 
It belongs to the Elephant group and is found in India, Nepal, Bhutan, Cambodia, China, Indonesia, Thailand,Vietnam, Myanmar, Malaysia, Lao People’s Democratic Republic, Srilanka, and Bangladesh, mainly in Forests and grasslands. 
Its diet consists of Grasses, bark, fruits, and roots, and it prefers Water sources, forests with dense vegetation, and mud baths. while avoiding Habitat loss and human disturbance.. 
It measures about Up to 3 Meters and weighs around 3,000–5,000 KG. 
With a lifespan of 50–70 Years, gestation period of  20–22 months, and clutch size of  1 calf, 
its conservation status is Endangered.. Found in: India, Nepal, Bhutan, Cambodia, China, Indonesia, Thailand,Vietnam, Myanmar, Malaysia, Lao People’s Democratic Republic, Srilanka, and Bangladesh. Likes: Water sources, forests with dense vegetation, and mud baths.. Dislikes: Habitat loss and human disturbance.. Fun facts: Elephants recognise themselves, understand relationships within their herd, and respond to the emotions of others — comforting distressed individuals and adjusting their behaviour to help them. Their trunks have over 40,000 muscles, more than the entire human body combined! Elephants ear perform several functions, they flap them to cool down, to hear subsonic sounds, and for threat displays. Their pulse can be taken from the base of the ear. Weight: 3,000–5,000 KG. Length: Up to 3 Meters.

भारतीय हाथी शक्ति और बुद्धि का प्रतीक है. घनिष्ठ पारिवारिक समूहों में रहते हुए, वे भोजन और पानी की तलाश में लंबी दूरी तय करते हैं और वन पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र को बनाए रखने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाते हैं. यह हाथी समूह से संबंधित है और भारत, नेपाल, भूटान, कंबोडिया, चीन, इंडोनेशिया, थाईलैंड, वियतनाम, म्यांमार, मलेशिया, लाओ पीपुल्स डेमोक्रेटिक रिपब्लिक, श्रीलंका और बांग्लादेश में मुख्य रूप से जंगलों और घास के मैदानों में पाया जाता है।. इसके आहार में घास, छाल, फल और जड़ें शामिल हैं, और यह जल स्रोतों, घनी वनस्पति वाले जंगलों और मिट्टी के स्नान को पसंद करता है।. पर्यावास हानि और मानवीय अशांति से बचते हुए. इसका माप लगभग 3 मीटर तक होता है और इसका वजन लगभग 3,000-5,000 किलोग्राम होता है. 50-70 वर्ष का जीवनकाल, 20-22 महीने की गर्भधारण अवधि और 1 बछड़े के क्लच आकार के साथ, 
.

Himalayan Goral (Naemorhedus goral) is classified under Mammal. Description: Here we have the Himalayan Goral, a remarkable animal from the Antelope and Bovid group. 
Native to Himalayan foothills of India, Nepal, China, Pakistan, and Bhutan., it thrives in Mountain slopes, rocky cliffs, and alpine forests.. 
It spends its time feeding on Grasses, herbs, and leaves. and enjoys Rocky hillsides, steep slopes, and forested mountain areas., but tends to avoid Human disturbance, habitat destruction, and extreme weather. 
With a size of  70–80 CM and weight of about 25–35 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 12–15 Years and is currently classified as Near Threatened.. Found in: Himalayan foothills of India, Nepal, China, Pakistan, and Bhutan.. Likes: Rocky hillsides, steep slopes, and forested mountain areas.. Dislikes: Human disturbance, habitat destruction, and extreme weather. Fun facts: Himalayan gorals are skilled climbers on steep cliffs while serving as grazers and browsers that shape high-altitude vegetation. Their hooves have rubber-like grips that stick to rock like climbing shoes! They can jump across deadly mountain gaps in a single leap- Jumping experts!! Weight: 25–35 KG. Length: 70–80 CM.

Asiatic Wild Dog (Dhole) (Cuon alpinus) is classified under Mammal. Description: Asiatic Wild Dog (Dhole) is a animal belonging to the Canids /  Dog Family group. 
It is found across South and Southeast Asia, including India, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, and southern China., typically in Tropical and subtropical forests, grasslands, and mountainous regions.. 
It feeds on A wide range of prey including deer, wild pigs, antelope, hares, rodents, and other small mammals; occasionally scavenges and enjoys Forests with abundant prey and water sources., while avoiding Habitat loss, human disturbance, and competition with other predators.. 
This species measures around 42–55 CM and weighs approximately 10–20 KG. 
It lives up to 10–12 Years, with a gestation period of About 60–63 days and clutch size of 4–8 pups. 
Its conservation status is Endangered.. Found in: South and Southeast Asia, including India, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, and southern China.. Likes: Forests with abundant prey and water sources.. Dislikes: Habitat loss, human disturbance, and competition with other predators.. Fun facts: Dholes use more than a dozen different vocalisations, including whistles, howls, yelps, and squeals, to communicate. Dholes are skilled pack hunters — working together to take down prey with teamwork rivalling lions and wolves! They use whistle-like calls to coordinate hunts - basically predator walkie-talkies! Weight: 10–20 KG. Length: 42–55 CM.

notes.en: Dholes are highly social animals that hunt cooperatively in packs and communicate using whistles and high-pitched sounds.

breeding_pattern.en: Dholes live in packs where one dominant female usually gives birth and the entire pack helps raise the pups.

story_description.en:
Asiatic Wild Dog (Dhole) is a animal belonging to the Canids /  Dog Family group. 
It is found across South and Southeast Asia, including India, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, and southern China., typically in Tropical and subtropical forests, grasslands, and mountainous regions.. 
It feeds on A wide range of prey including deer, wild pigs, antelope, hares, rodents, and other small mammals; occasionally scavenges and enjoys Forests with abundant prey and water sources., while avoiding Habitat loss, human disturbance, and competition with other predators.. 
This species measures around 42–55 CM and weighs approximately 10–20 KG. 
It lives up to 10–12 Years, with a gestation period of About 60–63 days and clutch size of 4–8 pups. 
Its conservation status is Endangered.
story_description.hi: एशियाई जंगली कुत्ता (ढोल) कैनिड्स/कुत्ता परिवार समूह से संबंधित एक जानवर है. यह भारत, नेपाल, भूटान, बांग्लादेश और दक्षिणी चीन सहित पूरे दक्षिण और दक्षिण पूर्व एशिया में पाया जाता है. , आमतौर पर उष्णकटिबंधीय और उपोष्णकटिबंधीय जंगलों, घास के मैदानों और पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में. यह हिरण, जंगली सूअर, मृग, खरगोश, कृंतक और अन्य छोटे स्तनधारियों सहित शिकार की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला को खाता है; . , जबकि पर्यावास हानि, मानवीय अशांति और अन्य शिकारियों के साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा से बचना. इस प्रजाति का माप लगभग 42-55 सेमी और वजन लगभग 10-20 किलोग्राम होता है. यह 10-12 साल तक जीवित रहता है, गर्भधारण की अवधि लगभग 60-63 दिन और क्लच का आकार 4-8 पिल्लों का होता है।. इसकी संरक्षण स्थिति लुप्तप्राय है.

narrative.en: Dholes are intelligent and cooperative hunters. Working together in packs, they can chase and bring down prey much larger than themselves.
narrative.hi: ढोल बुद्धिमान और सहयोगी शिकारी होते हैं। झुंड में मिलकर ये अपने से बड़े शिकार को भी पकड़ सकते हैं।

likes.en: Forests with abundant prey and water sources.
likes.hi: प्रचुर मात्रा में शिकार और जल स्रोतों वाले वन।

dislikes.en: Habitat loss, human disturbance, and competition with other predators.
dislikes.hi: पर्यावास की हानि, मानवीय अशांति, और अन्य शिकारियों के साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा।

threat_status.hi: संकटग्रस्त

fun_facts.en: Dholes use more than a dozen different vocalisations, including whistles, howls, yelps, and squeals, to communicate.
fun_facts.hi: ढोल संवाद करने के लिए एक दर्जन से अधिक विभिन्न स्वरों का उपयोग करते हैं, जिनमें सीटी, हाउल्स, येल्प्स और स्क्वील्स शामिल हैं।

fun_facts.en: Dholes are skilled pack hunters — working together to take down prey with teamwork rivalling lions and wolves!
fun_facts.hi: ढोल (Dhole) बहुत कुशल झुंड में शिकार करने वाले जानवर हैं — ये अपने झुंड के साथ मिलकर शिकार करते हैं और  उनकी एकजुटता शेरों और भेड़ियों को टक्कर देती है

fun_facts.en: They use whistle-like calls to coordinate hunts - basically predator walkie-talkies!
fun_facts.hi: शिकार के दौरान ये आपस में बात करने के लिए सीटी जैसी आवाज़ों का उपयोग करते है. बिल्कुल शिकारियों के 'वॉकी-टॉकी' की तरह!

Hanuman Langur (Semnopithecus entellus) is classified under Mammals. Description: The Hanuman Langur is a mammal belonging to the Primates group.
It is found across India and Bangladesh, mainly in dry forests, mountainous regions, temples, and urban areas.

It feeds on leaves, fruits, flowers, seeds, and insects, and is often seen sunbathing, grooming, and socializing in groups while living in trees.
This species measures around 45–75 cm and weighs approximately 10–20 kg.

It has a lifespan of about 18–20 years, with a gestation period of 6–7 months and usually gives birth to 1 infant at a time.
Its conservation status is Least Concern.. Found in: India and Bangladesh.. Likes: Sunbathing, grooming, social interaction, leafy trees. Dislikes: Predators, habitat disturbance, extreme cold. Fun facts: They digest toxic leaves that most animals avoid. A poison-proof stomach! [object Object] [object Object] Weight: 10–20 KG. Length: 45–75 CM.

The Hanuman Langur is a mammal belonging to the Primates group.
It is found across India and Bangladesh, mainly in dry forests, mountainous regions, temples, and urban areas.

It feeds on leaves, fruits, flowers, seeds, and insects, and is often seen sunbathing, grooming, and socializing in groups while living in trees.
This species measures around 45–75 cm and weighs approximately 10–20 kg.

It has a lifespan of about 18–20 years, with a gestation period of 6–7 months and usually gives birth to 1 infant at a time.
Its conservation status is Least Concern.
story_description.hi:
हनुमान लंगूर एक स्तनधारी जीव है, जो प्राइमेट्स समूह से संबंधित है।
यह भारत और बांग्लादेश में व्यापक रूप से पाया जाता है, मुख्यतः सूखे जंगलों, पर्वतीय क्षेत्रों, मंदिरों और शहरी इलाकों में।
यह पत्तियाँ, फल, फूल, बीज और कीड़ों का भोजन करता है तथा अक्सर धूप सेंकते, एक-दूसरे की सफाई करते और समूह में रहते हुए देखा जाता है।
इसकी लंबाई लगभग 45–75 सेमी होती है और इसका वजन लगभग 10–20 किलोग्राम तक होता है।
इसकी आयु लगभग 18–20 वर्ष होती है, गर्भकाल 6–7 महीने का होता है और यह सामान्यतः एक शिशु को जन्म देता है।
इसकी संरक्षण स्थिति “Least Concern” यानी कम चिंता वाली श्रेणी में है।

narrative.en:

It is commonly found in forests, temples, and urban areas across India, where it feeds on leaves, fruits, flowers, and seeds.
narrative.hi:
हनुमान लंगूर एक बड़ा बंदर है, जो अपनी लंबी पूँछ, काले चेहरे और धूसर रंग के फर के लिए जाना जाता है।
यह भारत के जंगलों, मंदिरों और शहरी क्षेत्रों में पाया जाता है तथा पत्तियाँ, फल, फूल और बीज खाता है।

story_audio.en: The acrobats of the trees. They use their long tails for balance while making those massive leaps.

fun_facts.en: They digest toxic leaves that most animals avoid. A poison-proof stomach!

Blackbuck Deer (Antilope cervicapra) is classified under Mammals. Description: The blackbuck is one of the fastest antelopes in the world. Its slender body and powerful legs allow it to run at high speeds across open grasslands. 
It belongs to the Deer /  Carved group and is found in India, Nepal, and reintroduced in Pakistan., mainly in Grasslands, open plains, and scrublands.. 
Its diet consists of Grasses, leaves, and pods., and it prefers Open plains with short grass and wide visibility. while avoiding Dense forests and heavy human disturbance.. 
It measures about 74–84 CM and weighs around 25–45 KG. 
With a lifespan of 12–16 Years, gestation period of About 5–6 months, and clutch size of 1 fawn, 
its conservation status is Least Concern.. Found in: India, Nepal; and reintroduced in Pakistan. Likes: Open plains with short grass and wide visibility.. Dislikes: Dense forests and heavy human disturbance.. Fun facts: Blackbucks can run up to 80 km/h. Male blackbucks have elegant spiral horns carved by nature Weight: 25–45 KG. Length: 74–84 CM.

narrative.en:
The Asiatic Black Bear, also called the Moon Bear, is known for the crescent-shaped white mark on its chest and its thick black fur.
It is mainly found in forested and mountainous regions of Asia, where it feeds on fruits, insects, honey, and small animals.
narrative.hi:
एशियाई काला भालू, जिसे मून बेयर भी कहा जाता है, अपनी छाती पर बने अर्धचंद्राकार सफेद निशान और घने काले फर के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
यह एशिया के पर्वतीय और वन क्षेत्रों में पाया जाता है तथा फल, कीड़े, शहद और छोटे जानवरों का भोजन करता है।

narrative.en: The Common Barn Owl is a medium-sized owl known for its heart-shaped face and silent flight. It is mostly nocturnal and is famous for controlling rodent populations, making it beneficial for farmers.

Black-headed Royal Snake (Spalerosophis atriceps) is classified under Reptiles. Description: Black-headed Royal Snake is a reptile belonging to the Lizards and snakes group. 
It is found across India, Nepal, and Pakistan., typically in Rocky deserts, scrublands, dry plains often shelters in rodent burrows.. 
It feeds on Rodents, lizards, and small birds. and enjoys Warm climates, open dry habitats, while avoiding Cold environments, heavy disturbance. 
This species measures around 1–1.5 Meter and weighs approximately 1–2 KG. 
It lives up to 10–12 Years, with a gestation period of 60–70 days and clutch size of 6–15 eggs. 
Its conservation status is not evaluated.. Found in: India, Nepal, and Pakistan.. Likes: Warm climates, open dry habitats. Dislikes: Cold environments, heavy disturbance. Fun facts: This non-venomous snake is often mistaken for a cobra due to its bold black head markings. Despite being short and slender, it can kill animals much larger than itself — tiny assassin mode! Weight: 1–2 KG. Length: 1–1.5 Meter.

Military Macaw (Ara militaris) is classified under Birds. Description: Here we have the Military Macaw, a remarkable bird from the Parrots, Parakeets and Macaws group. 
Native to  Mexico, Colombia, Bolivia, and Peru., it thrives in Subtropical and tropical mountain forests, dry woodlands, and foothills; often near river valleys.. 
It spends its time feeding on Seeds, nuts, fruits, and flowers. and enjoys Flocks, climbing, strong social interaction, but tends to avoid Isolation, habitat destruction, illegal trade. 
With a size of 70–80 CM and weight of about 1 KG, it is well adapted to its surroundings. 
This species lives for around 40–50 Years and is currently classified as not evaluated.. Found in: Mexico, Colombia, Bolivia, and Peru.. Likes: Flocks, climbing, strong social interaction. Dislikes: Isolation, habitat destruction, illegal trade. Fun facts: Military Macaws have bare white skin on their faces that can actually turn pink when they are excited or "blushing," much like humans. Despite their large size, Military Macaws use their powerful beaks like a "third foot" to climb trees and crack open nuts that are too tough for other animals. Weight: 1 KG. Length: 70–80 CM.

Sun Conure (Aratinga solstitialis) is classified under Birds. Description: The Sun Conure is a bright and lively parrot known for its vibrant colors and loud calls. It thrives in flocks and forms strong social bonds in the wild. 
It belongs to the Parrots, Parakeets and Macaws group and is found in various regions, mainly in Tropical forests, savannas, and palm groves.. 
Its diet consists of Fruits, nuts, seeds, and flowers., and it prefers Social interaction, flock living, climbing, playing while avoiding Isolation, lack of stimulation, habitat loss. 
It measures about 90–95 CM and weighs around 1–1.3 KG. 
With a lifespan of  50–60 Years, gestation period of 23–27 days, and clutch size of 2–3 eggs., 
its conservation status is not evaluated.. Found in: Bolivia, Brazil, Guyana, and Venezuela.. Likes: Social interaction, flock living, climbing, playing. Dislikes: Isolation, lack of stimulation, habitat loss. Fun facts: Their colours come from special light-reflecting feather structures, not just pigment — they literally glow in sunlight! Sun conures live up to their name — their bright yellow, orange, and red feathers resemble a living sunset. Weight: 1–1.3 KG. Length: 90–95 CM.

एडवर्ड तीतर वियतनाम का एक दुर्लभ और सुंदर पक्षी है. यह अपने चमकदार गहरे नीले-काले पंखों और चेहरे की लाल त्वचा के लिए जाना जाता है. एक समय इसे जंगल में विलुप्त माना जाता था, लेकिन अब यह संरक्षण प्रयासों का केंद्र बिंदु है. यह फ्रैंकोलिन्स और तीतर समूह से संबंधित है और मध्य वियतनाम में पाया जाता है. , मुख्यतः तराई के सदाबहार वनों में. इसके आहार में बीज, फल और छोटे अकशेरुकी जीव शामिल होते हैं. , और यह निवास स्थान के विनाश, मानवीय अशांति से बचते हुए घने जंगलों, शांत परिवेश को पसंद करता है. इसका माप लगभग 58-65 सेमी और वजन लगभग 1-1 है. 2 किलो. 10-15 वर्ष के जीवनकाल के साथ. , गर्भधारण अवधि लगभग 21-22 दिन, और क्लच का आकार 4-7 अंडे, 
.

narrative.en: Edward’s Pheasant is a rare and beautiful bird native to Vietnam. It is known for its glossy dark blue-black feathers and red facial skin. Once thought extinct in the wild, it is now the focus of conservation efforts.
narrative.hi: एडवर्ड का तीतर वियतनाम में पाया जाने वाला एक दुर्लभ और सुंदर पक्षी है। इसके पंख गहरे नीले-काले रंग के होते हैं और चेहरे के पास लाल त्वचा होती है। एक समय इसे जंगलों से विलुप्त माना गया था, लेकिन अब इसके संरक्षण के प्रयास जारी हैं।

fun_facts.en: One of the rarest pheasants on Earth, Edward’s pheasants were once thought to be extinct in the wild!

Zebra Finch (Taeniopygia guttata) is classified under Mammals. Description: Zebra Finch is a mammal belonging to the Munia and Finches group. 
It is found across Indonesia., typically in  Grasslands, savannas, and dry scrub. 
It feeds on Grass seeds, and grains. and enjoys Living in flocks, warm climates, while avoiding Extreme cold, isolation. 
This species measures around 10–12 CM and weighs approximately 12 Grams. 
It lives up to 5–7 Years, with a gestation period of 12–14 days and clutch size of 4–6 eggs.. 
Its conservation status is not evaluated.. Found in: Indonesia.. Likes: Living in flocks, warm climates. Dislikes: Extreme cold, isolation. Fun facts: Zebra finches sing unique songs like a vocal fingerprint — no two are the same — young males learn tunes from their fathers, just like cultural traditions! Each male has a unique song like a vocal fingerprint — no two are the same! Weight: 12 Grams. Length: 10–12 CM.

It feeds on Nuts, seeds, and fruits. and enjoys Social bonding, flying in pairs or flocks, climbing, while avoiding Habitat destruction, illegal pet trade. 
This species measures around 90–95 CM and weighs approximately 1–1.3 KG. 
It lives up to 50–60 Years, with a gestation period of 24–28 days and clutch size of 2–3 Eggs. 
Its conservation status is not evaluated.
story_description.hi: हरे पंखों वाला मैकॉ तोता, तोता और मैकॉ समूह से संबंधित एक पक्षी है. यह अर्जेंटीना, बोलीविया, ब्राज़ील, कोलंबिया, इक्वाडोर, गुयाना, पनामा, पराग्वे, पेरू, सूरीनाम, वेनेजुएला में पाया जाता है।. , आमतौर पर उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षावनों और नदी के किनारों में. यह मेवे, बीज और फल खाता है. और आवास विनाश, अवैध पालतू व्यापार से बचते हुए, जोड़े या झुंड में उड़ना, चढ़ाई करना, सामाजिक जुड़ाव का आनंद लेता है. इस प्रजाति की माप लगभग 90-95 सेमी और वजन लगभग 1-1 सेमी है. 3 किलो. यह 50-60 साल तक जीवित रहती है, गर्भधारण की अवधि 24-28 दिन और क्लच का आकार 2-3 अंडों के बराबर होता है।. इसके संरक्षण की स्थिति का मूल्यांकन नहीं किया जाता है.

narrative.en: The Green-winged Macaw is one of the largest parrots, known for its bright red body, green wing bands, and blue flight feathers. It has a strong curved beak and a gentle, social personality. It is often called the “gentle giant” among macaws.
narrative.hi: ग्रीन-विंग्ड मकाव सबसे बड़े तोतों में से एक है, जो अपने चमकीले लाल शरीर, हरे पंखों की पट्टी और नीले उड़ान पंखों के लिए जाना जाता है। इसकी मजबूत मुड़ी हुई चोंच और शांत, मिलनसार स्वभाव इसे “gentle giant” बनाता है।

likes.en: Social bonding, flying in pairs or flocks, climbing

dislikes.hi: पर्यावास का विनाश, अवैध पालतू व्यापार

story_audio.hi: इसके सफेद चेहरे पर लाल लकीरें देखिए। यह मैकाऊ प्रजाति के सबसे बड़े पक्षियों में से है।

fun_facts.en: These gentle giants are among the largest parrots and can live for 70 years or more  with proper care!
fun_facts.hi: ये शांत स्वभाव वाले विशाल तोते दुनिया के सबसे बड़े मकॉव में से हैं और अच्छी देखभाल के साथ 70 साल या उससे भी अधिक समय तक जी सकते हैं।

fun_facts.en: It’s one of the largest flying parrots after the Hyacinth macaws!

It spends its time feeding on Nuts, seeds, fruits, berries, flowers. and enjoys Warm climates, trees for nesting, and abundant food sources., but tends to avoid Cold environments, habitat loss, and human disturbance.. 
With a size of Varies widely depending on species and weight of about Varies widely depending on species, it is well adapted to its surroundings.

story_description.hi: यहां हमारे पास विदेशी पक्षी हैं, जो अज्ञात समूह समूह का एक उल्लेखनीय जानवर है. दक्षिण अमेरिका, अफ्रीका, ऑस्ट्रेलिया और दक्षिण पूर्व एशिया जैसे क्षेत्रों में प्राकृतिक रूप से पाए जाने वाले मूल निवासी. , यह उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षावनों, दलदलों, वुडलैंड किनारों में पनपता है. यह अपना समय मेवे, बीज, फल, जामुन, फूल खाकर व्यतीत करता है. और गर्म जलवायु, घोंसले के लिए पेड़ और प्रचुर भोजन स्रोतों का आनंद लेता है. , लेकिन ठंडे वातावरण, आवास हानि और मानवीय अशांति से बचने की प्रवृत्ति रखता है. इसका आकार प्रजातियों के आधार पर व्यापक रूप से भिन्न होता है और इसका वजन प्रजातियों के आधार पर व्यापक रूप से भिन्न होता है, यह अपने परिवेश के लिए अच्छी तरह से अनुकूलित होता है।. यह प्रजाति लगभग 10-40 वर्षों तक जीवित रहती है और वर्तमान में इसे कम चिंता वाले लुप्तप्राय के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है.

narrative.en: Exotic birds come from distant parts of the world and are admired for their vibrant colors, unique calls, and fascinating behaviors. They add incredible diversity to aviaries and help people learn about wildlife from different continents.
narrative.hi: विदेशी पक्षी दुनिया के दूर-दराज़ क्षेत्रों से आते हैं और अपने चमकीले रंगों, अनोखी आवाज़ों और दिलचस्प व्यवहार के लिए जाने जाते हैं। ये एवियरी में विविधता लाते हैं और लोगों को विभिन्न महाद्वीपों के वन्यजीवों के बारे में जानने का अवसर देते हैं।
